screenpix.us.description: Secretary of State William Russell (Henry Fonda) lives by his principles, but is haunted by a recent sexual indiscretion that threatens both his marriage and his career. Senator Joe Cantwell (Cliff Robertson) presents himself as the people's candidate, yet his determination to win at all costs is also his great flaw. These two frontrunners for their party's presidential nomination vie for the support of the outgoing president (Lee Tracy), and resort to mudslinging in a very public contest. (Drama) - 1964

screenpix.us.title: The Pusher
screenpix.us.description: A Manhattan drug addict (Kathy Carlyle) leads her policeman fiancé and father (Douglas F. Rodgers) to a killer pusher (Felice Orlandi). (Drama) - 1960

screenpix.us.title: Romeo and Juliet
screenpix.us.description: In this classic Shakespearean story, long-time adversarial families the Capulets and the Montagues engage in a street brawl, which results in a decree declaring that the next conflict will be punishable by death. But during an opulent masked ball, young Romeo Montague (Laurence Harvey) falls in love with Juliet Capulet (Susan Shentall). With the family feud reignited, Juliet's cousin kills Romeo's friend, Mercutio (Ubaldo Zollo), placing the young lovers in grave danger. (Romance) - 1954

screenpix.us.title: Electra
screenpix.us.description: When King Agamemnon returns from battle, he is slain by his wife, Clytemnestra (Aleka Katselli), and her lover. The king's son, Orestis (Giannis Fertis), is sent into exile, and his daughter, Electra (Irene Papas), into mourning. Over the years, Electra's hatred of her mother grows, and she bristles with the desire for vengeance. When she and Orestis are reunited, the siblings hatch a plot for revenge. But can they reconcile their need for justice with the act of matricide? (Drama) - 1962

screenpix.us.title: Moulin Rouge
screenpix.us.description: Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of Bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Portrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme. (Biography) - 1952

screenpix.us.title: Kingdom of the Spiders
screenpix.us.description: A veterinarian (William Shatner) and a bug expert (Tiffany Bolling) face thousands of Arizona spiders starved by pesticides. - 1977

screenpix.us.title: Die, Monster, Die!
screenpix.us.description: An American (Nick Adams) in England finds plants, animals and his future in-laws (Boris Karloff, Freda Jackson) mutated by a meteorite. - 1965

screenpix.us.title: Voodoo Island
screenpix.us.description: A writer famous for exposing hoaxes investigates a tropical island supposedly rife with voodoo horrors. - 1957

screenpix.us.title: The Pit and the Pendulum
screenpix.us.description: A plot to drive a man insane backfires when the intended victim adopts his late father's sadistic persona. - 1961

screenpix.us.title: The Gravedancers
screenpix.us.description: Angry spirits terrorize three reunited friends (Dominic Purcell, Josie Maran) after they disturb a cemetery following a funeral. - 2006

screenpix.us.title: The Initiation of Sarah
screenpix.us.description: When a coed is humiliated by a group of sorority sisters, she is urged to get even by unleashing her psychic powers. - 1978

screenpix.us.title: All or Nothing
screenpix.us.description: A cabdriver (Timothy Spall), his wife (Lesley Manville), a cashier and other working-class Britons deal with long hours and family problems. - 2002

screenpix.us.title: The Whisperers
screenpix.us.description: Familial problems and social-agency representatives disrupt the otherwise lonely existence of an elderly woman. - 1967

screenpix.us.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
screenpix.us.description: A South African policeman (Nicol Williamson) tracks an activist (Sidney Poitier) and an Englishman (Michael Caine) to an anti-apartheid leader. - 1975

screenpixaction.us.title: Run for the Sun
screenpixaction.us.description: Katie Connors (Jane Greer), a writer for a tabloid magazine, travels to Mexico to find reclusive novelist Mike Latimer (Richard Widmark). When she uncovers him, the two develop feelings for each other, and Mike offers to fly her back to Mexico City. After their plane crashes in the jungle they are rescued by an Englishman named Browne (Trevor Howard), who seems very hospitable at first but soon reveals a sinister hobby. He is a hunter who preys on "the most dangerous game": man. (Thriller) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Pork Chop Hill
screenpixaction.us.description: Because final peace negotiations are bogged down in political maneuvering, U.S. soldiers, led by Lt. Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck), are forced to assault entrenched Chinese troops. The site of battle is Pork Chop Hill, a daunting, desolate climb that gives the communist forces a clear advantage. Clash after deadly clash wears down the morale and readiness of Clemons' men, and when they ask for backup, command is neither willing to send reinforcements nor authorize a retreat. (War, Drama) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: Kings Go Forth
screenpixaction.us.description: During World War II, in a picturesque town on the French Riviera, U.S. Army Lt. Sam Loggins (Frank Sinatra) and Cpl. Britt Harris (Tony Curtis) both fall for the same local girl, the American-born Monique Blair (Natalie Wood). But when the soldiers learn that Monique and her mother (Leora Dana) had moved to France from the United States to escape discrimination against her parents' interracial marriage, each man must examine his own bigotry and prejudices. (War, Drama) - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: The Purple Plain
screenpixaction.us.description: At the end of World War II in Burma, Canadian Royal Air Force pilot Forrester (Gregory Peck) is a loner whose bravery can't cover a streak of reckless instability. When his actions cause an injury, he is nearly transferred, but Dr. Harris (Bernard Lee) recommends pulling him from duty, due to the emotional trauma he's suffered. Forrester then accompanies Harris to a Christian missionary outpost, where he meets Anna (Win Min Than) and begins to find interest in living again. (Adventure, Action) - 1954

screenpixaction.us.title: Ten Seconds to Hell
screenpixaction.us.description: After the end of World War II, six German soldiers return to Berlin and form a bomb disposal unit. Defusing bombs is extremely risky business, so every week the group contributes to a fund that will go to the last man standing. Only Karl Wirtz and Eric Koertner are left, and their once solid friendship is starting to crack. Adding to the tension is their rivalry over a local woman and one last job that could change everything. (Thriller) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: Beachhead
screenpixaction.us.description: During World War II, four Marines land on a Pacific island to execute the rescue of French planter Bouchard (Eduard Franz) and his daughter, Nina (Mary Murphy). With Japanese soldiers hidden throughout the dense jungle landscape, the Marines face a daunting trek to reach their target and must endure even greater danger on the return trip with the two French citizens. In the end, one of the Marines, Burke (Tony Curtis), carries the responsibility of getting everyone to safety. (War, Drama) - 1954

screenpixaction.us.title: The One That Got Away
screenpixaction.us.description: Franz von Werra (Hardy Kruger) is a Luftwaffe pilot by trade, but an escape artist by necessity. When his plane is attacked over England, he initiates his first effort to break out of the POW camp only days after arriving. Transferred to a second, more secure facility, Franz nevertheless manages to tunnel out and very nearly steals an airplane before being recaptured. This time the Allies send him to be imprisoned in Canada, but he steadfastly insists that no cell will hold him. (Adventure, Action) - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: Hell's Belles
screenpixaction.us.description: When biker Dan (Jeremy Slate) wins a motorcycle race, he wants to sell the bike he receives as a prize and use the cash to buy a ranch. But the bike is stolen by Tony (Michael Walker) and finds its way into the hands of Tampa (Adam Roarke), so Dan goes on a quest for revenge. He tracks down Tampa and his gang and uses a variety of tools to neutralize them, all in pursuit of his prized motorcycle. Dan's worried girlfriend, Cathy (Jocelyn Lane), tags along for the violent ride. (Action) - 1969

screenpixaction.us.title: The Wild Angels
screenpixaction.us.description: When Hell's Angels member Loser (Bruce Dern) has his motorcycle swiped, he entreats his gang to help him seek the bike, and revenge. Gang leader Heavenly Blues (Peter Fonda) and his lady, Mike (Nancy Sinatra), succeed in tracking down the thieves, but when a fracas breaks out between the gangs, the cops shoot Loser, putting him in the hospital. The rest of the Angels try to rescue Loser from his sickbed, wreaking havoc in the ward and doing their buddy more harm than good. (Action) - 1966

screenpixaction.us.title: Angels From Hell
screenpixaction.us.description: A veteran's homecoming includes acid trips, pot parties and easy women as well as his old role as leader of the pack. (Crime drama) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: The Glory Stompers
screenpixaction.us.description: Chino (Dennis Hopper) is the head of the Black Souls, a California motorcycle gang at odds with another crew, the Glory Stompers. One day, Chino and his fellow gang members kidnap the head of the Stompers, Darryl (Jody McCrea), and his girlfriend, Chris (Chris Noel). After a heavy beating, the cyclists abandon Darryl but take Chris with them to Mexico. While Chris faces threats of abuse, Darryl teams up with Smiley (Jock Mahoney), an aging ex-Stomper, for a final showdown with the Souls. (Action) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: The Mini-Skirt Mob
screenpixaction.us.description: The leader (Diane McBain) of a motorcycle gang harasses her ex-boyfriend and his bride (Sherry Jackson) on their highway honeymoon. (Action) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: The Savage Seven
screenpixaction.us.description: A motorcycle gang terrorizes a Native American reservation -- until the gang's leader, Kisum (Adam Roarke), falls for waitress Marcia Little Hawk (Joanna Frank). The two groups soon put aside their differences to team up against crooked Fillmore (Mel Berger), who employs Marcia and her brother, Johnnie (Robert Walker). But Fillmore decides to encourage dissent among them, arranging for the death of a gang member and framing a Native American -- which leads Kisum to plot an attack on the town. (Action) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: Born Losers
screenpixaction.us.description: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy. (Crime drama) - 1967

screenpixaction.us.title: The Secret Place
screenpixaction.us.description: Robbers try to retrieve gems that fell into the hands of a policeman's son. (Crime drama) - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: Lord of Illusions
screenpixaction.us.description: A private eye (Scott Bakula) looks after the wife (Famke Janssen) of an illusionist (Kevin J. O'Connor) who killed his mentor, the leader of a black-magic cult. - 1995

screenpixaction.us.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
screenpixaction.us.description: Insane aristocrat Roderick Usher (Vincent Price), thinking his sister (Myrna Fahey) is dead, buries her alive. - 1960

screenpixaction.us.title: The Masque of the Red Death
screenpixaction.us.description: A tyrannical 12th-century prince is intrigued by a girl and takes her to live amid the immorality of his court. - 1964

screenpixaction.us.title: The Raven
screenpixaction.us.description: Three sorcerers (Vincent Price, Peter Lorre, Boris Karloff) bicker the black-magic way in 15th-century England. - 1963

screenpixaction.us.title: I Bury the Living
screenpixaction.us.description: The chairman (Richard Boone) of a cemetery thinks a person dies when he moves their pin on a plot chart. - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: The Premature Burial
screenpixaction.us.description: Based on Edgar Allan Poe's story about a cataleptic Englishman obsessed with the fear of being buried alive. - 1962

screenpixaction.us.title: The First Power
screenpixaction.us.description: A Los Angeles policeman (Lou Diamond Phillips) hunts a killer (Jeff Kober) brought back from the gas chamber by Satan. - 1990

screenpixaction.us.title: The Ghost of Sierra de Cobre
screenpixaction.us.description: Vivia Mandore, an heiress, enlists the services of a paranormal investigator to look into a suspected case of haunting involving the spirit of her deceased mother-in-law. - 1964

screenpixaction.us.title: My Gun Is Quick
screenpixaction.us.description: Private eye Mike Hammer (Robert Bray) passes over women and corpses to find stolen jewels. - 1957

screenpixvoices.us.title: Truck Turner
screenpixvoices.us.description: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily. (Action) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: Odds Against Tomorrow
screenpixvoices.us.description: Disgraced former police officer David Burke (Ed Begley) is looking for a way to make some quick money. When he decides to rob a bank, he calls on mean ex-con Earle Slater (Robert Ryan) and black entertainer Johnny Ingram (Harry Belafonte) to help him pull off the heist. Johnny is reluctant to agree but is forced to reconsider because of his significant gambling debts, while racist Earle balks because of Johnny's involvement. Ultimately, though, they must work together to get the job done. (Crime drama) - 1959

screenpixvoices.us.title: Diary of a Hitman
screenpixvoices.us.description: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task. (Crime drama) - 1992

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Organization
screenpixvoices.us.description: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

screenpixvoices.us.title: Soda Cracker
screenpixvoices.us.description: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner. (Crime drama) - 1989

screenpixvoices.us.title: Friday Foster
screenpixvoices.us.description: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt. (Crime drama) - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: Sheba, Baby
screenpixvoices.us.description: When the loan business of her father, Andy (Rudy Challenger), is trashed by thugs looking to force a sale, Chicago private investigator Sheba Shayne (Pam Grier) travels back to her hometown of Louisville, Ky., to even the score. Together with old flame Brick Williams (Austin Stoker), she attacks the henchmen of local loan shark Pilot (D'Urville Martin), but a retaliation leaves Andy dead. Blind with rage, Sheba vows to take out Pilot's boss, mob kingpin Shark (Dick Merrifield). (Action) - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: Black Mama, White Mama
screenpixvoices.us.description: Lee Daniels (Pam Grier) is a black girl busted for prostitution. Karen Brent (Margaret Markov) is a white girl arrested for her involvement with a local revolutionary group. The two women meet in jail and, despite their mutual animosity, are chained together for transport to a maximum security prison. Their bus is ambushed en route, however, and the pair manages to escape together. Chased by bounty hunters, crooked police and revolutionaries, they struggle to get along and get away. (Action) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Drum
screenpixvoices.us.description: A slaver (Warren Oates) buys Drum (Ken Norton), a bordello queen's (Silvia Pinal) son, in the 1860s New Orleans. (Drama) - 1976

screenpixvoices.us.title: Bucktown, U.S.A.
screenpixvoices.us.description: After his brother's death, Duke Johnson (Fred Williamson) travels to a small Southern town to organize his brother's funeral. During his stay, he decides to revive his brother's nightclub business. However, this venture quickly uncovers the thinly veiled racism and corruption that run rampant in the town. Duke and his friend Aretha (Pam Grier) face demands for bribes and violence from the police. With the arrival of Duke's pal Roy (Thalmus Rasulala), the situation only escalates. (Action) - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hollywood Shuffle
screenpixvoices.us.description: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson). (Comedy) - 1987

screenpixvoices.us.title: Catch the Heat
screenpixvoices.us.description: An agent (Tiana Alexandra) works as an exotic dancer to nab a drug smuggler (Rod Steiger) who hides heroin in breast implants. - 1987

screenpixvoices.us.title: Article 99
screenpixvoices.us.description: A surgeon (Ray Liotta) and his colleagues show a new doctor (Kiefer Sutherland) how to cut red tape at a poorly run hospital for veterans. - 1992

screenpixvoices.us.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
screenpixvoices.us.description: Detectives Coffin (Raymond St. Jacques) and Gravedigger (Godfrey Cambridge) question a con-man preacher (Calvin Lockhart) and his back-to-Africa movement. - 1970

screenpixvoices.us.title: Blind Rage
screenpixvoices.us.description: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines. - 1978

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hollywood Shuffle
screenpixvoices.us.description: A struggling black actor must decide whether success is worth compromising his integrity for a stereotypical role. - 1987

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Surrender at Sunglow
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister and Harris Claibourne spring into action when the nearby town of Sunglow is besieged by criminals in the wake of its sheriff's murder. (Western) - 1959-05-15

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Grave Near Tombstone
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Sheriff Hollister volunteers to escort a young visitor to see her uncle on a nearby ranch, but her relative appears to be missing, and the man's partner is less than helpful. (Western) - 1959-05-22

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The year is 1908, and aging adventurer Sam Longwood (Lee Marvin) and his gang of crooked cowboys have been cheated out of a big score by their own cohort, Jack Colby (Robert Culp). After years of searching, Sam finally tracks Colby down and decides to take revenge against his former accomplice. Sam regroups his old circle of grifters, and they hatch a scheme to get their hands on Colby's fortune; however, nothing seems to go smoothly for these ramshackle scam artists. (Western, Comedy) - 1976

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The King and Four Queens
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The four McDade brothers stage a successful heist -- except that three of them are killed. When their wives and mother learn that only one of the young men survived with the loot, they are eager to find out which one. Slick traveler Dan Kehoe catches wind of this strange situation and decides to charm the women in hopes of eventually enjoying the spoils. Before long, however, the lonely females begin competing for Dan, disintegrating into a cut-throat battle royal for his heart. (Western, Comedy, Adventure, Drama) - 1956

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Valerie
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Versions differ as a Civil War hero (Sterling Hayden) stands trial out West for shooting his wife (Anita Ekberg) and her family. (Drama) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Rancho Deluxe
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Cattle rustlers Jack McKee (Jeff Bridges) and Cecil Colson (Sam Waterston) steadily steal cows from wealthy rancher John Brown (Clifton James). When his two hapless ranch hands (Harry Dean Stanton, Richard Bright) fail at capturing the thieves, Brown calls upon the services of Henry Beige (Slim Pickens), a cattle rustler turned detective -- although Beige does little more than sit around all day. But as they continue to get away with their crimes, McKee and Colson become a little too confident. (Western, Comedy, Romance) - 1975

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Claim
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Dillon (Peter Mullan) is a pioneer who defied the harsh winter in search of rumored gold. Having amassed unimaginable riches, he runs a thriving mining town called Kingdom Come. But the blind ambition and greed that drove him to succeed finally catches up to him with the arrival of 3 strangers. Dalglish (Wes Bentley) a surveyor looking to expand the railroad threatens the future of the town -- and 2 women from Dillon's past hold a secret that could be his undoing. (Drama) - 2000

screenpixwesterns.us.title: From Noon Till Three
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bank robber Graham Dorsey spends a few hours with beautiful widow Amanda Starbuck, in which time his gang takes part in a disastrous holdup. Learning of his comrades' demise, Dorsey goes on the lam. Believing her short-term lover was killed by the law, Amanda decides to make the most of having had a liaison with the supposedly deceased desperado by writing a book about him. Much to his confusion, the still-living Dorsey watches as his name becomes legendary. (Western, Comedy) - 1976

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Fort Massacre
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After his cavalry company is decimated by an Apache attack, Vinson takes charge and tries to lead his remaining men to safety. Unfortunately, his pathological hatred of Native Americans causes him to commit rash acts that put his troops in jeopardy. The enlisted men, especially the rebellious McGurney, question Vinson's leadership and even his morality, but the soldiers must stick together if they wish to make it through Apache lands. (Western) - 1958

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Trooper Hook
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Wanted for killing a squadron of soldiers, Apache Chief Nanchez (Rudolfo Acosta) is finally captured by Sgt. Clovis Hook (Joel McCrea), who discovers among Nanchez's prisoners Cora Sutliff (Barbara Stanwyck), who had been missing for several years. Sutliff has not only fully integrated into the Apache way of life, she also has a son with Nanchez. Now Hook wants to transport her back to her old way of life, but Nanchez isn't willing to let his son be taken from him. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Escort West
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In the wake of the Civil War, ex-Confederate soldier Ben Lassiter and his 10-year-old daughter, Abbey, are traveling through Nevada when they cross paths with sisters Martha and Beth Drury. Although Martha is embittered because her fiancé was killed by a Confederate during the war, she is forced to trust Ben when a band of Native Americans tries to attack the sisters, and the soldier offers his protection. (Western) - 1959

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Glory Guys
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Inspired by the Battle of the Little Bighorn, this Western follows a selfish military leader, Gen. Frederick McCabe (Andrew Duggan), who unfeelingly throws his soldiers into dangerous battle situations, and the soldiers who must follow his orders. While waiting to be sent into combat, two of the men -- Harrod (Tom Tryon) and Rogers (Harve Presnell) -- find themselves in the midst of a love triangle as they both pursue the heart of the beautiful Lou Woddard (Senta Berger). (Western, Drama, Romance) - 1965

Thompson (Ben Johnson), so he tries to get rid of the captain by ordering him to track Victorio (Larry Chance), a notorious Apache warrior who's plotting a large-scale attack on the fort. (Western) - 1958

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Davy Crockett, Indian Scout

Suspicions fall on Davy's innocent partner, Red Hawk (Philip Reed), so he and Davy set out to find the real culprit. (Western) - 1950

Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. skycinemafamily.uk.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Trolls
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Poppy, the optimistic leader of the trolls, and Branch, her polar opposite, embark on an adventure that takes them far beyond the only world they've ever known.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Tafiti: Across the Desert
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When his grandfather gets bitten by a snake, a young meerkat embarks on an adventure across the desert to find the magical flower that can cure him.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Boss Baby
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative Seven-year-old named Tim. The most unusual Boss Baby arrives at Tim's home in a taxi, wearing a suit and carrying a briefcase. The instant sibling rivalry must soon be put aside when Tim discovers that Boss Baby is actually a spy on a secret mission, and only he can help thwart a dastardly plot that involves an epic battle between puppies and babies.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. Their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Annie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Daddy Warbucks opens his estate to a spunky orphan in this adaptation of the popular comic strip and hit Broadway show.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Too
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Now
skycinemafamily.uk.description: In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Karate Kid: Legends
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Small Soldiers
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A toy company develops action-figure soldiers whose realistic fighting capabilities cause mayhem for a toy-shop owner and his family. Unaware of their military prowess, the shopkeeper takes delivery of the soldiers, who break free from their packaging to attack their Gorgonite enemies. When the Gorgonites communicate with the shopkeeper's son, the humans find themselves under siege.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Gabby's Dollhouse: The Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When Gabby's dollhouse, her most prized possession, ends up in the hands of an eccentric cat lady named Vera, she sets off on an adventure through the real world to get the Gabby Cats back together before it's too late.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hotel Transylvania
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenage daughter.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula decides to put his grandson through 'monster' boot camp. Then, Dracula's father unexpectedly pays a visit.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Super-Charlie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young boy attempts to solve an ongoing series of crimes with the help of his super-powered baby brother.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Happy Feet
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Son of Memphis and Norma, little sweet penguin Mumble has a big problem: he can't sing a single note. skycinemafamily.uk.title: Happy Feet Two

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Canada in the Rough - New Brunswick Mountain Moose
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Keith Beasley is hunting moose with his bow in New Brunswick with Cherry on Top Adventures. He hunts hard on foot and has a number of close encounters during his week hunting. (Outdoors, Hunting) - 2020-03-17

sportsmanchannel.us.title: The Gamekeepers of Mossy Oak - GK Podcast #370 - Managing Wildlife with Science
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Being joined by Dr. Bronson Strickland and Mitt Wardlaw of Wildlife Investments; we discuss whitetails, food plots and techniques to mitigate the fall food plot planting challenges; listen, learn and enjoy. (Outdoors, Hunting) - 2026-06-29

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Fishing Beast - Giant Speckled Trout Fishing
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Learn the secrets of micro jig fishing before joining the Catch of the Week at MABEC Outfitters. (Fishing) - 2026-08-10

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Ducks Unlimited - Red Oaks For Mallards Part 2
sportsmanchannel.us.description: This week on DUTV our cameras join Co-Host Jim Ronquest, Jody Pagan of Ecosystems Protection Services, and former DU President George Dunklin on some action packed timber duck hunting at Dunklin's Five Oaks Duck Lodge in Arkansas.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Chasing the 29 - The Elusive Eland by Day & Jackals by Night
sportsmanchannel.us.description: The pursuit of the African 29 continues as Chase takes on two very different hunts in the African Bush; during the day, he sets his sights on Eland; when the sun goes down, the hunt takes a completely different turn.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Buckmasters - Western Whitetails
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Jackie and Jacob Landry are back at one of Jackie's favorite places to hunt whitetails. Montana!

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Everything Eichler - Whitetails and Hogs Down South
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Bows, rifles and handguns are all coming out to go after whitetails and hogs in Florida.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Westcoast Sporting Journal - Winter Harbour Tuna
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Flat water and calm winds chasing Albacore Tuna.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Trijicon's World of Sports Afield - Looking Forward to Looking Back
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Today we take a look back at some of our favorite hunts of the past season of Trijicon's World of Sports Afield.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Bowhunter TV - Heartland Whitetail
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Curt Wells hunts in Missouri using a variety of tactics, and his persistence pays off when he arrows a quality Missouri heartland whitetail.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Greg McHale's Wild Yukon - No Easy Way Up: Earning a Billy
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Greg heads into steep, rain-soaked Yukon mountains in pursuit of a mature billy goat; the terrain is unforgiving, with slick rock and long climbs testing every step; in true goat country, the reward only comes after earning it the hard way.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Five Star Redneck
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Five Star Redneck takes you deep into the heart of Outdoor Adventure, where family, friendships, and a love for wilderness come together. Hosted by a fun-loving crew of redneck adventurers, this series showcases a wide range of outdoor activities.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Jokers Wild off the Hook - Indiana Small Pond Fishing
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Sparky heads to Indiana in pursuit of big bass on their ponds while on our hunting adventure fall 25.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Homegrown Hunter TV - Africa Adventures, Part 1
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Canadian hunting adventures.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Backwoods Backstage - Chasing New Zealand Part 1
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Brett and crew head to New Zealand to get after everything the beautiful kiwi backcountry has to offer.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Live 2 Hunt With Cody & Kelsy - Lessons Learned
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Jack Casement learns the extreme highs and lows of bowhunting whitetail!

sportsmanchannel.us.title: The Western Hunter - Gem State Jackpot Part 1
sportsmanchannel.us.description: The Western Hunter documents the journeys of public land hunters out West. The stories unfold in some of the most wild and beautiful settings on the continent in pursuit of big game.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Handguns - Barricade Work
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Whether for competition or self-defense, working around a barricade is an important skill to develop.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Chicks and Machines - Women on the Trails
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Cyndi and Coralie explore New Brunswick by Honda motorcycle before joining an all-women snowmobile clinic in Charlevoix filled with learning, adventure and connection.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Big Coast - North King Chinook
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Travel North from Bella Bella to remote Caamano Sound and North King Lodge for fine Chinook salmon angling.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Descendants of the North - Spring Black Bear
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Helgie is hard at it setting up bear camp and prepping for a visit from his kids.

sportsmanchannel.us.description: Following Retired Professional Boxer King Bedford on hunts all over the country, inspiring and educating the next generation of hunters.

sportsmanchannel.us.description: Len becomes the oldest official guide in British Columbia, and he guides Hal to a big black bear on Vancouver Island.

On the way, the couple happen upon Elysium, an idyllic counterculture community, where money, careers and clothing are strictly optional. teennick.us.description: Max and Phoebe attend a parent-teacher night, leaving Chloe to have friends over without adult supervision; Jinx finds the Air Lair and believes spies are targeting the school and his meddling puts Max and Phoebe's school jobs at risk. (Children, Fantasy) - 2025-03-12

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Going Wonkers
teennick.us.description: A comet affects the Thundermans' powers; Phoebe's crush asks her to a school dance; Phoebe and Max must stick together to keep their powers in check. (Children, Sitcom) - 2014-02-08

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Meet the Evilmans
teennick.us.description: When a retired supervillain -- Thunder Man's old nemesis -- moves to Hiddenville, Phoebe secretly begins dating his son. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-02-23

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Cheer and Present Danger
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Cherry's friendship is tested when only one of them makes the cheerleading squad; Max wins a month of free pizza. (Children, Sitcom) - 2014-11-15

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Z's All That
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max act as superhero mentors to one of their siblings but quickly regret selecting Nora after seeing Billy's surprisingly impressive skills. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-01-06

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Pretty Little Choirs
teennick.us.description: The twins work together to get even with a mean girl at school. (Children, Sitcom, Adventure, Action) - 2014-05-03

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Beat the Parents
teennick.us.description: When Max feels nervous about meeting his girlfriend's parents, he seeks Phoebe's help to try and win them over. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-07-16

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Up, Up, and Vacay!
teennick.us.description: The Thundermans enter a competition to win a dream vacation, but they can not agree on a destination. (Children, Sitcom, Adventure, Action) - 2014-05-31

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - This Looks Like a Job For
teennick.us.description: Max and Phoebe get jobs at a pizza parlor; Max and Phoebe must work together to save their jobs. (Children, Sitcom) - 2013-11-30

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Doubles Trouble
teennick.us.description: Phoebe enlists Max's help in a tennis tournament in order to win a membership at Link's family's country club. (Children, Sitcom, Action) - 2015-02-26

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Adventures in Supersitting
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max Thunderman are twins in a family of superheroes; Phoebe strives to use her powers for good, and Max embraces the dark side.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Floral Support
teennick.us.description: Max uses Phoebe to help retrieve his chronicle of evil deeds from the school's confiscation closet, but breaks her trust to pull off his plan.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Kiss Me Nate
teennick.us.description: Max is nervous when his girlfriend auditions for the romantic lead in the school play opposite a cute boy, so he convinces Phoebe to audition for the same role.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - From Dust Till Dawn
teennick.us.description: Chloe struggles with her leadership skills; when a villain attacks her school field trip, Max and Phoebe have to put Chloe in charge while they try to take down the villain and defuse his dangerous astronomical weapon.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - The Parent Zap
teennick.us.description: After Phoebe and Max let Chloe's friends watch a horror movie and eat candy, Jinx and Booch's parents want to meet Chloe's; with Hank and Barb away, Max and Phoebe transform into them to help Chloe; it goes well until the real Hank and Barb show up.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Read Aloud; Not a Loud
teennick.us.description: The family embarks on a reading challenge at the library, but Lola refuses to participate; when Lincoln discovers the first page of his baby book is blank, he worries his parents are hiding something.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - House Music; A Novel Idea
teennick.us.description: Lincoln's family forms a band when he signs them up for a talent show; Lincoln's mother offers to take him to the dental office where she works; his sisters go to work with their father.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Friends in Dry Places; Coupe Dreams
teennick.us.description: While on a field trip, Lincoln worries that his friend group is splintering; to buy her dream car, Lori becomes a local ride-share driver.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Love Birds; Rocket Men
teennick.us.description: After Walt's failed attempt at romance, Charles, Cliff and Geo try to find their pal a love connection; Lincoln and Clyde beg their parents to let them go to space cadets camp, but it's not as fun as they expected.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Lincoln Loud: Girl Guru; Come Sale Away
teennick.us.description: Lincoln and Clyde must start a business for a class assignment, so they decide to sell Lincoln's girl expertise; the children are determined to out-sell each other at the Loud family's annual garage sale.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Picture Perfect; Undie Pressure
teennick.us.description: Lincoln hatches a plan to capture the perfect family photograph for his parents' anniversary gift; Lincoln and his sisters make a bet on who can go the longest without engaging in their most annoying habits.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Fam Scam; Farm to Unstable
teennick.us.description: Embarrassed by her family, Lola pretends to be a McBride to impress her new sophisticated pageant friend; after realizing farm work with Liam is harder than they thought, Lincoln and the gang look for shortcuts.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Wheel and Deal; Feast or Family
teennick.us.description: Lana and Lincoln enter to compete in a soap box derby; Luan must enroll in a culinary class.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Cat-astrophe; Prize Fighter
teennick.us.description: The McBrides plan a birthday party for Nana Gayle; Lola worries she's a washed-up pageant star.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - How Double Dare You!; Snoop's On
teennick.us.description: The siblings turn to Lisa's intelligence to help them land a spot on "Double Dare"; after secretly reading Luna's diary, Leni and Lincoln become worried about the exploits their sister writes about.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Road Trip: Bizarritorium
teennick.us.description: Mom is assigned a travel article at work, and she takes the entire family on a cross-country road trip; the trip gets off to a bumpy start when Lincoln tries to change Mom's itinerary to go to Dr. Weirdly's Bizarritorium.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Party Fowl; Sleepless in Royal Woods
teennick.us.description: When Sergio stays at the Louds', he soon gets into trouble when he doesn't want to hang out with the rest of the pets; unable to get Lily to go to sleep, Mom takes her for a drive, and they happen to witness a burglary.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Waking History; Pranks Fore Nothing
teennick.us.description: Eager to uncover secrets from the past, Lisa uses her technology to wake up a frozen caveman; to win the prank war between Fairway University and their rival Par College, Lori recruits the help of Luan.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Child's Play; Force of Habits
teennick.us.description: Luna and the Moon Goats try to form a kiddie band to raise enough money for new equipment; when Lori mentions her new boyfriend's habit, Lori and Luna start to notice their partners' habits.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Last Laugh; Driver's Dread
teennick.us.description: Luan thinks Mr. Coconuts is out for revenge when she replaces him with Lola in her act; hoping to drive out to the outlets to meet Lori, Leni looks for alternative ways to get her driver's license.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Save the Last Pants; A Stella Performance
teennick.us.description: Rusty tries to bring the fun of Gus' to Duds For Dudes when he's in charge of the store; Stella wins a school competition and is super excited until she learns she has to give a public presentation.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - No Such Luck; Frog Wild
teennick.us.description: The sisters think Lincoln is bad luck so they ban him from attending their activities; when Lincoln finds out his class is dissecting frogs, he and Lana embark on a mission to rescue them.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Boss Maybe; Family Bonding
teennick.us.description: Leni, the oldest in the house, struggles to follow in Lori's footsteps as the family's babysitter; secret agents Lincoln and Clyde investigate the Louds' suspicious new neighbors.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - A Grave Mistake; Leader of the Rack
teennick.us.description: Lucy faces off against her friend Haiku to become the new president of the Young Morticians' Club at school; Leni is promoted to temporary manager at work, but worries about remaining good friends with Miguel and Fiona.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Much Ado About Noshing; Broadcast Blues
teennick.us.description: Lynn's Table gets a bad review; the Action News Team must cater to Chandler's demands after he buys new equipment.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Fandom Pains; Rita Her Rights
teennick.us.description: Lucy becomes annoyed when Lori and Leni start watching her vampire show because of a cute new character; Mom gets community service for racking up tickets.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Teacher's Union; Head Poet's Anxiety
teennick.us.description: Lincoln and Clyde set Coach Pacowski and Mrs. Johnson up in an effort to make gym class better; Luan teaches Lucy how to manage the ups and downs of pursuing a life in the arts.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Write Stuff; Racing Hearts
teennick.us.description: Mom takes over when Lucy quits the writing club at school due to the by-the-book way Huggins runs the club; Luna and Sam embark on a challenge taking place across Royal Woods and discover they have less in common than they thought.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Potty Mouth; L Is for Love
teennick.us.description: When the children hear Lily curse, they become worried that they have been a bad influence on her; when a love letter addressed to L. Loud arrives, the family tries to figure out who it was meant for.

themoviechannel.us.title: Before Dawn
themoviechannel.us.description: A young man joins his countrymen on the Western front of World War I, hoping to expedite an end to the bloody conflict. However, as the battle rages on, he's forced to grapple with the brutal realities of trench warfare, including a near-constant struggle to keep himself alive without leaving another man behind. (War, Historical drama) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Baby Driver
themoviechannel.us.description: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Bleed for This
themoviechannel.us.description: Vinny "The Pazmanian Devil" Pazienza (Miles Teller), a local Providence boxer, shoots to stardom after winning two world title fights. After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story. (Biography, Drama) - 2016

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream
themoviechannel.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Match Point
themoviechannel.us.description: Tennis instructor Chris Wilton (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) grows friendly with Tom Hewett (Matthew Goode), a wealthy student who shares an interest in opera. Invited to attend a performance with Tom, Chris meets the family and instantly attracts Tom's sister, Chloe (Emily Mortimer). Chris marries her to get a job with her millionaire father, Alec (Brian Cox), but a dangerous affair with Nola Rice (Scarlett Johansson), Tom's American girlfriend, threatens his newfound social status. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Barron's Cove
themoviechannel.us.description: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: A Perfect Murder
themoviechannel.us.description: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. (Thriller) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Fatal Attraction
themoviechannel.us.description: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. (Thriller, Drama, Romance) - 1987

themoviechannel.us.title: Basic Instinct
themoviechannel.us.description: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect. (Thriller) - 1992

themoviechannel.us.title: Double Jeopardy
themoviechannel.us.description: Framed for the murder of her husband, Libby Parsons (Ashley Judd) survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Dark comedy, Mystery) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: The Perfect Gamble
themoviechannel.us.description: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino. (Crime drama) - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: Love, Rosie
themoviechannel.us.description: Rosie and Alex are best friends until Alex's family moves to America. They gamble everything to keep their love and friendship alive over the years and miles. (Romantic comedy) - 2014

themoviechannel.us.title: Santa Stole Our Dog!
themoviechannel.us.description: Members of the Whitehaven family travel to the magical North Pole when their beloved dog Rusty goes missing on Christmas Eve. (Children, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: The Comeback Trail
themoviechannel.us.description: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making. (Comedy) - 2020

themoviechannel.us.title: Surviving Christmas
themoviechannel.us.description: A wealthy executive, Drew Latham has no close relationships and becomes nostalgic for his childhood home as Christmas approaches. When he visits the house and finds another family living there, he offers the residents, Tom Valco and his wife, Christine, a large sum of money to pretend they are his parents. Soon Drew tests the couple's patience, and, when their daughter, Alicia, arrives, things get increasingly tense. (Holiday, Dark comedy, Romantic comedy) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: The Fitzgerald Family Christmas
themoviechannel.us.description: Rifts emerge among family members when their long-estranged patriarch decides to come home for the holidays. (Holiday, Comedy drama) - 2012

themoviechannel.us.title: He's Just Not That Into You
themoviechannel.us.description: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna. (Romantic comedy) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Magic Mike XXL
themoviechannel.us.description: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again. (Comedy drama) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
themoviechannel.us.description: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue. (Romantic comedy) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
themoviechannel.us.description: Befuddled mom-to-be Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) must figure out which of the two men (Colin Firth, Patrick Dempsey) in her life is the father of her child. - 2016

themoviechannel.us.title: He's Just Not That Into You
themoviechannel.us.description: Friends and lovers try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships, sometimes misconstruing the true intentions of the opposite sex. - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud. - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: Our Friend
themoviechannel.us.description: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home. - 2019

themoviechannel.us.title: Blue Valentine
themoviechannel.us.description: A couple (Ryan Gosling, Michelle Williams) find that they are powerless to stop the downward spiral of their marriage. - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Regarding Henry
themoviechannel.us.description: Two bullets force a career-driven Manhattan lawyer (Harrison Ford) to start life over with his loving wife (Annette Bening) and daughter. - 1991

themoviechannel.us.title: Christmas Takes Flight
themoviechannel.us.description: A number-crunching CEO buys a family-owned airline and cancels the airline's annual holiday charitable benefit. A pilot rallies the community to help save the event and unexpectedly finds herself falling for the magnate in the process. - 2021

theweatherchannel.us.title: America's Morning Headquarters
theweatherchannel.us.description: Starting the day by opening a window into weather, looking out at the stories and science behind the forecast. (Community) - 2021-06-14

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Strawberry Blonde
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: At the turn of the century, dentist Biff Grimes (James Cagney) recalls his association with politician Hugo Barnstead (Jack Carson). The men meet over their romantic rivalry for striking strawberry blonde Virginia Brush (Rita Hayworth). Despite Biff's efforts, Virginia pushes her friend, nurse and women's rights advocate Amy Lind (Olivia de Havilland), on him and elopes with Hugo. After Biff and Amy fall in love, Biff joins Hugo's firm, only to learn that his rival is still a double dealer. (Romantic comedy) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Flower Drum Song
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this adaptation of the 1958 Rodgers and Hammerstein Broadway musical, Chinese immigrant Mei Li (Miyoshi Umeki) is betrothed to nightclub boss Sammy Fong (Jack Soo), but he wants to marry showgirl Linda Low (Nancy Kwan). To get out of the arrangement, Sammy pawns her off to wealthy Master Wang (Benson Fong) as a fiancée for his son, Wang Ta (Victor Sen Yung). Mei Li falls in love with Wang, but he wants to pursue Linda, who takes advantage of his affections to test Sammy's love. (Musical comedy) - 1961

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Camelot
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After the arranged marriage of Arthur (Richard Harris) and Guinevere (Vanessa Redgrave), the king gathers the noble knights of the realm to his Round Table. The dashing and stalwart Lancelot (Franco Nero) joins, but soon finds himself enraptured by the lovely Guinevere. When Arthur's illegitimate son, Mordred (David Hemmings), reappears in the kingdom and outs the secret lovers, Arthur finds himself trapped by his own rules into taking action against his wife and closest friend. (Musical) - 1967

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: An American in Paris
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jerry Mulligan is an American ex-GI who stays in post-war Paris to become a painter, and falls for the gamine charms of Lise Bouvier. However, his paintings come to the attention of Milo Roberts, a rich American heiress, who is interested in more than just art. (Musical, Romance) - 1951

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Top Hat
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The story centers on wealthy Dale Tremont (Ginger Rogers), on holiday in London and Venice. She assumes that American entertainer Jerry Travers (Fred Astaire) is the husband of her friend Madge (Helen Broderick) -- who's actually the wife of Jerry's business manager Horace Hardwick (Edward Everett Horton). (Musical, Romance) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: West Side Story
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A musical in which a modern day Romeo and Juliet are involved in New York street gangs. On the harsh streets of the upper west side, two gangs battle for control of the turf. The situation becomes complicated when a gang member falls in love with a rival's sister. (Musical) - 1961

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Places in the Heart
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1935 rural Texas, recently widowed Edna Spalding struggles to survive with two small children, a farm to run and very little money in the bank -- not to mention a deadly tornado and the unwelcome presence of the Ku Klux Klan. Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret; a blind boarder, Mr. Will; and a would-be thief, Moze, who decides to stick around to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton. (Drama) - 1984

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Absence of Malice
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Megan Carter is a reporter duped into running an untrue story on Michael Gallagher, a suspected racketeer. He has an alibi for the time his supposed crime was committed, but it involves an innocent party. When she tells Carter the truth and the newspaper runs it, tragedy follows, forcing Carter to face up to the responsibilities of her job when she is confronted by Gallagher. (Drama) - 1981

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Smokey and the Bandit
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Big Enos (Pat McCormick) wants to drink Coors at a truck show, but in 1977 it was illegal to sell Coors east of the Mississippi River without a permit. Truck driver Bo "Bandit" Darville (Burt Reynolds) agrees to pick up the beer in Texas and drive it to Georgia within 28 hours. When Bo picks up hitchhiker Carrie (Sally Field), he attracts the attention of Sheriff Buford T. Justice (Jackie Gleason). Angry that Carrie will not marry his son, Justice embarks on a high-speed chase after Bandit. (Comedy) - 1977

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Hooper
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sonny Hooper (Burt Reynolds) is getting too banged up to remain Hollywood's top stuntman, but he signs up as the stunt coordinator for a big-budget action movie with a pushy director (Robert Klein) and a clueless star (Adam West). Ready to retire from the physical abuse, Hooper is gearing up to make the film's climactic stunt his biggest ever, but cocky young stuntman Ski Chinski (Jan-Michael Vincent) aims to steal the glory with his more scientific, technology-oriented stunt methods. (Action) - 1978

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Murphy's Romance
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Emma (Sally Field), a divorced single mother seeking to start her life over, moves to a small town in Arizona. She builds a relationship with Murphy (James Garner), the older local pharmacist but, due to his age, it remains platonic. Their friendship becomes complicated when Emma's ex-husband, Bobby Jack (Brian Kerwin), shows up. He claims to have changed his ways, but when he turns out to be the same man Emma divorced, she discovers her true feelings for Murphy. (Romantic comedy) - 1985

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Doughboys
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Elmer (Buster Keaton) is a privileged and affluent young man who has never wanted for a thing in his whole life. Then he falls for a beautiful USO performer named Mary (Sally Eilers), who finds his lack of concern for his fellow man deeply appalling. After Elmer mistakenly enlists in the military, he is offered a second chance with this lovely lady, though he has some stiff competition in the form of the suave and tough Sgt. Brophy (Edward Brophy). (Comedy) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Speak Easily
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Thanks to his butler (Jimmy Durante), a professor (Buster Keaton) thinks he has inherited a fortune and lives it up. (Comedy) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Passionate Plumber
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A woman of Paris (Irene Purcell) poses a plumber (Buster Keaton) as her lover to make her boyfriend jealous. (Comedy) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Free and Easy
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Elvira (Anita Page) wins a beauty contest in her home state of Kansas, her clumsy manager, Elmer Butts (Buster Keaton), must take her to Hollywood for a chance at movie stardom. Forbidden to access the studios, Elvira and Elmer attend a film premiere and ogle at the many stars. In desperation, Elmer breaks onto a movie set -- and despite bumbling onto various active sets, wins a part as an extra. Meanwhile, Elvira attracts the attention of handsome film star Larry (Robert Montgomery). (Comedy) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Pick a Star
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A small town Iowa girl heads to Hollywood with dreams of stardom and becomes a big star owing to a publicity agent. (Musical comedy) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Burn 'Em Up O'Connor
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jerry O'Connor is a tractor operator who would rather be a race-car driver; Buddy Buttle is his backwoods friend. Race-car magnate Pinky Delano, obsessed with breaking speed records, sees O'Connor in a small-time auto race, hires him to be one of his racers and hires Buddy to be a mechanic. But, after several of Delano's drivers die in freak accidents, O'Connor suspects foul play and fears that he may be next. (Drama) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Death on the Diamond
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A rookie pitcher for the St. Louis Cardinals investigates the mysterious murders of several of his teammates. (Mystery) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Murder in the Fleet
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A traitor is lurking somewhere aboard the USS Carolina, and Lt. Tom Randolph (Robert Taylor) is determined to find the offender. First a revolutionary new piece of technology -- an electric firing device -- is sabotaged. Then one of the cruiser's crew is murdered. In order to catch the killer, the captain locks down the ship. With foreign dignitaries, corporate goons and even Tom's girlfriend, Betty (Jean Parker), trapped on the vessel, there is no shortage of suspects. (Mystery) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Air Raid Wardens
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In a small town during World War II, the bumbling duo Stan (Stan Laurel) and Ollie (Oliver Hardy) seem to fail at everything they attempt. Rejected from enlisting in the army, the hapless Stan and Ollie volunteer as air raid wardens, all the while partaking in numerous business ventures that are doomed to fail. When they are inevitably fired as air raid wardens, the two have a shot at redemption when they discover a Nazi spy ring planning to destroy a magnesium plant. (Comedy) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: A Southern Yankee
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The Union army sends an eager-beaver bellhop (Red Skelton) south to spy, by posing as a Confederate spy. - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The life and 50-year career of director Mike Nichols, one of only two people who have won Peabody, Emmy, Grammy, Oscar and Tony awards.

Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Thriller, Action, Adventure, Crime drama) - 2016

actionmax.us.title: Black Butterfly
actionmax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Aniara
actionmax.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Science fiction, Drama) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
actionmax.us.description: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run. (Thriller) - 2019

actionmax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1

actionmax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire

actionmax.us.title: Tomb Raider
actionmax.us.description: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Shot Caller
actionmax.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
actionmax.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (Action, Thriller) - 2013

actionmax.us.title: Man Down
actionmax.us.description: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location. (Thriller, Drama) - 2015

actionmax.us.title: Smoking Tigers

actionmax.us.title: The Return of Godzilla
actionmax.us.description: Okumura witnesses a huge monster during a storm. Biologist Hayashida hears Okumura's story from Toto Nippo reporter Maki and concludes that Godzilla, who was buried 30 years ago, has come back to life. Godzilla then appears in Tokyo Bay. (Science fiction) - 1984

actionmax.us.title: The Hitcher
actionmax.us.description: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders. (Thriller) - 1986

actionmax.us.title: Epic
actionmax.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2013

actionmax.us.title: The Flash
actionmax.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2023

actionmax.us.title: The Player
actionmax.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy) - 1992
