moremax.us.title: Epic
moremax.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
moremax.us.description: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era. (Music) - 2019

moremax.us.title: Colette
moremax.us.description: After moving to Paris, author Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette agrees to ghostwrite a semi-autobiographical novel for her husband. Its success soon inspires her to fight for creative ownership and overcome the societal constraints of the early 20th century. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Miss Sloane
moremax.us.description: Willing to bend the rules for her clients, Elizabeth Sloane (Jessica Chastain) remains one of the most sought-after lobbyists in Washington, D.C. When asked to help oppose a bill that imposes regulations on firearms, she instead joins a scrappy boutique firm that represents the backers of the law. Her defiant stance and determination to win now makes her the target of powerful new enemies who threaten her career and the people she cares about. (Drama, Thriller) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
moremax.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Spring Breakers
moremax.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

moremax.us.title: Lady Bird
moremax.us.description: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school. (Comedy drama) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Life of Pi
moremax.us.description: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive. (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2012

moremax.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
moremax.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (Crime drama) - 1999

moremax.us.title: Hall Pass
moremax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: MacGruber
moremax.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Player
moremax.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy) - 1992

moremax.us.title: Aftermath
moremax.us.description: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter. (Thriller, Drama, Action) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Chasing Mavericks
moremax.us.description: When 15-year-old surfing phenomenon Jay Moriarty discovers that the mythic Mavericks surf break, one of the biggest waves on Earth, actually exists near his California home, he becomes determined to conquer it. Jay enlists the aid of local surfing legend Frosty Hesson to train him to ride the Mavericks and live to tell about it. As Jay and Frosty carry on their quest to achieve the impossible, they develop a unique friendship that transforms both their lives. (Docudrama, Adventure) - 2012

moremax.us.title: Brian Banks
moremax.us.description: The inspirational true story of Brian Banks, an all-American high school football star who finds his life upended when he's wrongly convicted of a crime he didn't commit. Despite the lack of evidence, Banks gets railroaded through a broken justice system and sentenced to a decade of prison and probation. Years later, with the support of Justin Brooks and the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of playing in the NFL. (Biography, Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Nerve
moremax.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Thriller, Action, Adventure, Crime drama) - 2016

moremax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
moremax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

moremax.us.title: The Switch
moremax.us.description: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

moremax.us.title: A History of Violence
moremax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

moremax.us.title: Solace
moremax.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2015

moremax.us.description: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) saves dismal Gotham City and gorgeous Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger) from the freaky Joker (Jack Nicholson). - 1989

moremax.us.description: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) clashes with Catwoman (Michelle Pfeiffer) and saves gloomy Gotham City from the foul Penguin's (Danny DeVito) plot. - 1992

natgeo.ca.title: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
natgeo.ca.description: Renowned dog behaviorist Cesar Millan comes back not only to rehabilitate dogs, but to train pet parents as well. With empty shelters and dog adoptions at a record high, his return to television gives new pet parents the tools they need to teach their dogs good habits and shed the bad ones. In addition, he helps pet parents better understand the connection that dogs have with their humans, and how people's actions can influence just how well, or poorly, their dogs behave. From the yards of the pet owners to his newly updated Dog Psychology Center, Cesar demonstrates the skills needed to create happy homes with furry best friends while equipped with a can-do attitude. (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2021

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E6 Best Of Nordic Cookery Part 2 Tareq Taylor looks back on his food adventures and delicacies from Nordic countries.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E15 Autumn Fruit And Nuts Its Autumn and the new seasons array of Fruit and Nuts sees Maggie and Simon whip up a collection of captivating flavours. For Maggie, Autumn means Vintage in the Barossa.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E4 Some Like It Hot Hot sauce hive unite! Mary spices it up with recipes that bring the heat, including maple sriracha salmon and spicy pickled Caesar beans.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Outback Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Justine explores Darwin, visiting the Parap Markets and enjoys a beautiful breakfast laksa. She then joins MasterChef alumni Rachel Ciesiolka for a seafood cook-off at Rachel's Seafood Shack.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Girl's Guide to Hunting, Fishing and Wild Cooking
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Conquering her fear of bees, Analiese gets her first beehive before heading off on an adventure of foraging, fishing and diving with best friend and famous Thai restaurateur, Palisa Anderson.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paddock To Plate
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E8 The Kimberley As his journey concludes, Matt explores the vast Kimberley Region and it's spectacular coast. He cooks locally farmed barramundi, mud crab and pearl meat and travels to a cattle station for an end-of-muster feast.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E17 The French Laundry Experience Marooned in San Francisco, Tony tastes local shellfish and durian ice cream before embarking on a pilgrimage to experience the genius of Thomas Keller, chef, and owner of The French Laundry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E18 Traditional Tastes Tony is invited to experience the culinary heart and distinct walled medinas (districts) of the Moroccan city Fez.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E86 Gather Around It's time to gather around, as urban gardener Connie Cao and chef Alastair McLeod join Adam to make food that's best for sharing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Bergen, Norway Bergen is a thousand-year-old city built on the back of the seafood trade especially cod.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E24 Fruits And Sweets In the summer, it was time to wait for the fruits in Lidia's trees to ripen. She prepares a fig and prosciutto bruschetta, wafer cookies into truffles, and make almond tarts from Andria.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E1 Cheeses Of Greece The ancient Greeks regarded cheese as Food of the Gods, and it's no surprise that in Greece today, the consumption of cheese per head of population is the highest in the world.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Madikwe Safari In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Rapallo Rapallo keeps its secrets well. Behind its tranquil appearance lies a town full of delightful surprises. Luana begins by ascending to the Sanctuary of Montallegro.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E6 Best Of Nordic Cookery Part 2 Tareq Taylor looks back on his food adventures and delicacies from Nordic countries.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E6 Bo Carne: Nana's Half Caste Stew & Magpie Goose Giblet & Heart Blachan Everyone has a stew they can brag about. In this episode, Bo Carne shares his Nana's version of the good old billabong stew.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E15 Autumn Fruit And Nuts Its Autumn and the new seasons array of Fruit and Nuts sees Maggie and Simon whip up a collection of captivating flavours. For Maggie, Autumn means Vintage in the Barossa.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E29 Episode 29 Laura's mum, Anita, joins her in the kitchen with a quick family favourite, Zucchini Pasta. Guest host Shane Jolley teams up with Chef Mod to cook an Asian classic, Seared Salmon in Massaman Curry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E29 Cacciatore With Jeremy Sisto Actor and family friend Jeremy Sisto joins Rachael in her Tuscan kitchen to learn how to make Hunter's Chicken, known in Italy as Cacciatore served with generous helpings of bruschetta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Little Manly Beach The BBQ is setup on the pier overlooking Little Manly on a perfect day for Hayden's recipes: Portuguese chicken burgers, tarte Tatin, and mushroom-stuffed salmon.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Not Your Butter Chicken
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Darkness To Light This episode, filmed during the festival of light known as Diwali, focuses on the new era of Indo-Canadians rewriting the script on family as they celebrate a fresh take on cultural traditions.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E24 Episode 24 Laura & Daen prepare a baked snapper with salsa verde; Heather makes kake soba with fish cakes & onsen eggs; Tobie Puttock cooks raspberry chia jam cooked on renewable gas; Catherine puts together a Dominican traditional soup with a twist.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 This episode highlights heart-healthy, diabetes-conscious recipes: T-bone steak with garlic and herb baste, a fetta and quinoa salad with cumin dressing, and Bò lá lôt.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E86 Gather Around It's time to gather around, as urban gardener Connie Cao and chef Alastair McLeod join Adam to make food that's best for sharing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E5 Meat Cute Mary uses easier-on-your-wallet meat cuts to make flavourful dishes, like pork chops au poivre and her mom's signature grilled flank steak.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E25 Corn: From The Kernel To The Husk Today is all about corn. Recipes include a refreshing corn zucchini minestra, a polenta cacio e pere, and a mix of vegetables that can be served as a side dish - grilled corn, apricots, and portobello.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E2 Basque Sheperds Cheeses Will visits the pretty village of Espelette to sample its red peppers, before travelling into the mountains to one of the few remaining traditional shepherds huts where where they milk ewe's by hand.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 The Garden Route A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 Alassio In Alassio, everything seems effortlessly perfect. Warm smiles, timeless elegance, and culinary delights define this day dedicated to the pleasures of Riviera life.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Malmo, Sweden Tareq is in his hometown of Malmo-Sweden's third largest city. Built upon the backs of herring in the sea, the town is now a centre of culture and technology with a bridge connecting it to Copenhagen.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E7 Helani Doolah: Sop Sop, Sabee Domboi, And Marinated Fried Fish With Battered Banana Using knowledge from her grandmother and other family members, Helani Doolah will show and teach us how to make some staple dishes that are made every day in the Torres Strait Islander community.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E16 Autumn Fruit And Veg Simon takes some new seasons vegetables and shows us how to pickle ginger and daikon, while Maggie uses ginger to make an eggplant salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E30 Episode 30 Laura is in the market kitchen making the naughtiest donuts you'll ever see Nutella and Praline Donuts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E30 Bacalao Con Pomodoro Rachael shows how to make Bacalao con Pomodoro, a dish inspired by an amazing meal she shared with John during a special trip to Elba, a Mediterranean island in Tuscany.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Manly Cove Hayden starts the day with an early morning run with his running club, before he gets his BBQ on to serve up a glazed salmon side, hot pork rolls, and a mushroom and ricotta pizza.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Not Your Butter Chicken
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 What Will People Say Shiva looks inward and contemplates the impacts of living in fear of social judgment and a common reprimand of her childhood, \.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E25 Episode 25 Laura is visited by potato farmer Rene Pye who learns how to make a Chicken & Potato Curry for her family.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 Featuring Arrnott Olsen, Gary turns to bright coastal flavours with a Fijian fish curry, hiramasa kingfish crudo, and South Indian fish moilee with South Indian red rice.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E54 Episode 54 If you haven't tried Dukkah, we encourage you to! Kate Weiss joins Justine and shows off her beautiful Dukkah Roasted Cauliflower Salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S5 E85 Festival Of Lights It's Easy Entertaining with The Cook Up, and Adam is celebrating Diwali, the festival of lights, with chefs Gunjan Aylawadi and Nagesh Seethiah.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Hotel Chocolat At Christmas
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Behind the scenes at Hotel Chocolat as they count down to Christmas. With the ambition to design, make and sell over 50 million chocolates this year, it's going to be a busy time for the team.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: We're a nation that loves our curry. But in Greater Manchester, there's one venue that's bigger and bolder than all the rest-The Royal Nawaab.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E19 Portugal: Cod Crazy Tony travels to Porto, home of the famous Port wine, where he is immediately exposed to the codfish and the almost mythical place it holds in Portuguese cuisine and culture.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S5 E85 Festival Of Lights It's Easy Entertaining with The Cook Up, and Adam is celebrating Diwali, the festival of lights, with chefs Gunjan Aylawadi and Nagesh Seethiah.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Malmo, Sweden Tareq is in his hometown of Malmo-Sweden's third largest city. Built upon the backs of herring in the sea, the town is now a centre of culture and technology with a bridge connecting it to Copenhagen.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E25 Corn: From The Kernel To The Husk Today is all about corn. Recipes include a refreshing corn zucchini minestra, a polenta cacio e pere, and a mix of vegetables that can be served as a side dish - grilled corn, apricots, and portobello.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E2 Basque Sheperds Cheeses Will visits the pretty village of Espelette to sample its red peppers, before travelling into the mountains to one of the few remaining traditional shepherds huts where where they milk ewe's by hand.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 The Garden Route A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 Alassio In Alassio, everything seems effortlessly perfect. Warm smiles, timeless elegance, and culinary delights define this day dedicated to the pleasures of Riviera life.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of The Tropics
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Taste Of The Tropics: Foodie Friends Cairns chef Davy O'Rourke, who specialises in Mexican and South American cuisines, honours the tradition of his country of birth by cooking a Papua New Guinean mumu under the guidance of his mum.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E7 Helani Doolah: Sop Sop, Sabee Domboi, And Marinated Fried Fish With Battered Banana Using knowledge from her grandmother and other family members, Helani Doolah will show and teach us how to make some staple dishes that are made every day in the Torres Strait Islander community.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E16 Autumn Fruit And Veg Simon takes some new seasons vegetables and shows us how to pickle ginger and daikon, while Maggie uses ginger to make an eggplant salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E30 Episode 30 Laura is in the market kitchen making the naughtiest donuts you'll ever see Nutella and Praline Donuts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E30 Bacalao Con Pomodoro Rachael shows how to make Bacalao con Pomodoro, a dish inspired by an amazing meal she shared with John during a special trip to Elba, a Mediterranean island in Tuscany.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Manly Cove Hayden starts the day with an early morning run with his running club, before he gets his BBQ on to serve up a glazed salmon side, hot pork rolls, and a mushroom and ricotta pizza.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Not Your Butter Chicken

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 Featuring Arrnott Olsen, Gary turns to bright coastal flavours with a Fijian fish curry, hiramasa kingfish crudo, and South Indian fish moilee with South Indian red rice.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Behind the scenes at Hotel Chocolat as they count down to Christmas. With the ambition to design, make and sell over 50 million chocolates this year, it's going to be a busy time for the team.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Join Adam Liaw as he revisits the highlights from his Scandinavian food adventures.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The World's Biggest Curry Restaurant
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: We're a nation that loves our curry. But in Greater Manchester, there's one venue that's bigger and bolder than all the rest-The Royal Nawaab.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Hong Kong One hundred years ago, there was a Dai Pai Dong, or street food stall, on every Hong Kong street corner, serving up super fast, mouthwatering, and affordable meals.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Coromandel Tane comes from the sea with a bag of kai moana. He pulls out a bottle of kombucha and offers it to Sachie, telling her it is made from seaweed. Sachie and Tane collect seaweed.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Marcus In The Med: Mallorca
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Lazy Breakfasts Marcus wants to discover unique Mallorcan breakfasts and he begins his search at Mistral, the first cafe on the island to roast their own coffee.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Feast By Fire
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Fire & Fat Jess travels to Burnt Bean Co, where the pork chop gets the full BBQ treatment. She then returns home to demonstrate her own version, revealing how to keep the meat juicy, build flavour, and nail the perfect finish on a cut anyone can find.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Thai Street Food: Best Kept Secrets
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Khanom Wan Experience the streets of Thailand through the eyes of the sellers making some of the country's oldest and most traditional desserts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Global Soul Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Black Eyed Pea Biryani Chef Deborah VanTrece brings together Southern and Indian flavours with her black-eyed pea biryani.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Donal's Feasts, Fasts And Festivals
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Donal joins a Muslim family who are fasting during Ramadan, explores the traditions of the Romanian Orthodox Community as he prepares a traditional Easter meal and joins in the atmosphere of Diwali.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Inside Sydney Fish Market
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Under The Pump Seven weeks after opening, the new Sydney Fish Market faces its first Good Friday as fuel costs, wild weather and an auction failure threaten Easter supplies.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Thailand And Malaysia Rick takes a train to Phuket to learn the art of hot and sour tom yum goong, the culinary icon of Thailand. Later he meets up with one of his cooking heroes, David Thompson.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E5 Cuba's Savory Secrets In search of Cuba's most authentic and delicious ingredients, Gordon embraces local ingenuity as he fishes and forages his way across the island.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Taste Of Malta
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Central Ainsley is in central Malta where he starts his day exploring the beautiful ancient city of Mdina. After a tour of the city, Ainsley stops by a restaurant with an impressive history and a great view.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E3 Wiggly Superheroes Join The Wiggles for this Superhero Adventure! With a bedsheet to make a cape, and a bit of imagination and Sunflower Power to make their superhero powers, they're ready to help out their friends!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Swing with a Stomp During the concert, Doc Ock steals the drumset and uses it to hypnotize the entire audience!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 Wishing Tree Evil Pea blows all the lanterns away during the Lantern Festival. Supertato struggles to get them all back and needs Broccoli's help to save the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E3 Museum Mayhem / Big Dig Lab Rat and Ginny learn what makes their art special. Sparks learns to share his upset feelings.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E23 Ben's Birthday Card Holly forgets Ben's birthday, and rushes home to make him a birthday card. But Nanny has stopped all magic, so Holly has to make the card herself. When she takes the card to Ben she is embarrassed that it is hand-made.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E37 Ghost Pumpkin Flower and Unicorn Cuzzy decide to create creepy faces on pumpkins for the Spooky Night Party coming up. But they freak out when one of their pumpkins seems to come to life!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 Little Sister When Flower begs her parents for a little sister, she borrows Tutu for the day to see what it's like; but chaos quickly erupts. In the end, Flower realizes she already has the perfect playmate: Flour.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E42 The Owl Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig build a special bird watching hut so that they can spot an owl at night.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E43 The Apple Tree Peppa and family enjoy their garden apple tree all year round, through Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 Wagon Ride Bluey can't wait to get to the monkey bars as Dad takes her and Bingo on a wagon ride to the park. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat with other grown-ups.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 Taxi Bluey is running a taxi service. Her first passenger is Businessman Dad, who is in a rush to get to the airport. But with unexpected delays, Dad's in danger of missing his flight!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E2 Hatchling When an egg cracks to reveal a baby Avocadodon, Ginger and the Pea-Rexes have to find a fun way to lead the energetic baby back to its herd.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E2 Dance Off Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes guide a young Strawberrisaurus to find the courage to perform a special friendship dance that will help them find a lifelong playmate.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zog
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 The Fun Doctor When Mara calls Pearl sensible, she wants to prove how fun she is. With her eye off the ball, Pearl starts to make medical mistakes. Can she be a fun doctor?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E30 The Snowman Badge The Squirrels make a snow slug and the penguins make a snow bird. Each new snow creation trumps the last, they get bigger, better, more exciting. And in the end, they make an enormous snow slide together!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Song of Peace Betty recalls the first time she pushed the BIG RED BUTTON, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story and the gerbils sing a song of peace and unity.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E13 Electricity Fizzy and Suds follow power lines to explore wind and solar energy, watch a firefly animation, and use balloons to discover the magic of static electricity. Zap-tastic!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E13 Big And Small: Sea Miah and Michelle explore all things big and small in the sea! Michelle makes a small sailboat, and races Miah's big tugboat. In the big Play School pop-up book a little boat sails in the big blue sea.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piggy Builders ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 Cloud The Piggies create a floating cushion for Fiona, who wishes to be on a cloud. But Wilf falls asleep on it, and they now must catch the cloud before it drifts away!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 To The Lighthouse / The Golden Giant When a storm blows out the lighthouse light, Santi and crew hurry to guide Mami and Abuelo back from sea. / When Enrique awakens a giant, Santi and crew must find a way to save the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Peppa Pig: Wedding Party! Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow surprise everyone with their wedding announcement and everyone rallies around to make it memorable!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E46 Super Smart Script Ben gets an invitation to a super-brainy event that turns out to be a trap set by Professor Kranium.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 Flower's Tea Shop Flower and Flour set up a boba tea stall, excited to be the best in the plaza. But when Rudy's over-the-top \.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E49 Kiddie Workout Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead the playgroup in a fun musical workout for children.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E21 Bump on the Noggin After bumping his head, Gadabout forgets he ever became a doctor and returns to his knightly ways. Zog and Pearl show him the bravest thing you can do is care for others.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E23 The Mixtape Badge The Squirrels are exploring in the attic when they find an old cassette tape, and decide to make a mixtape for Duggee to remind him of all the happy memories they've made while earning their badges.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superbuns
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E28 For the Record Buns wants to claim a Bunny World Record. But when each of her record attempts is dashed, her friends help her break the record for super acts of kindness!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Get the Boot Lab Rat invents a giant boot to smush all the flowers at the Kittydale Flower Festival.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E11 Parents Wizz does not want you to meet his parents because he thinks they're embarrassing. Or is it because they want him to him to take part in a family tradition: jumping over a cactus.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E1 Dance Mode After Dad eats her last chip, Bingo is given three chances to put Mum and Dad in 'Dance Mode' as payback. But the others can't resist taking Bingo's turns for her.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E5 The Golden Age of Piracy, Black Holes, Wallace and Gromit and US Presidents The kids are back on air! Who will win Tom Gleeson's Big Brass Mug? ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S10 E5 All Puffed Up Valerie Bertinelli and Duff Goldman ask the eight kid bakers to work in teams of two to build and decorate tasty, beautiful puff designs made of two different colours and flavours of cream puffs.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 Heat 5 Legend's legs get him into trouble on the Collision Bridge, and Fury gets ferocious in The Ring. Hold tight for the comeback of the series so far.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E16 Nightmare of Eden: Part 4 The Doctor solves the mystery of the drug smuggling racket and the culprits are revealed. But unless the Doctor and Romana act quickly, the villains will escape justice.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E17 The Horns of Nimon: Part 1 With the TARDIS disabled in order to undergo repairs, the Doctor is powerless when Romana is kidnapped by a battleship which is on its way to Skonnos and the formidable Nimon.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E18 The Horns of Nimon: Part 2 On Skonnos, Romana and the Athenian youngsters are forced into the labyrinth of the power complex to meet their fate at the hands of the Nimon.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E19 The Horns of Nimon: Part 3 Trapped inside the power complex, the Doctor and Romana begin to suspect that the Nimon is only the first of a full scale invasion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E20 The Horns of Nimon: Part 4 On the dying world of Crinoth, Romana discovers the truth behind the Nimon’s empty promises. The Doctor must find a way to shut down the power complex on Skonnos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E1 The Leisure Hive: Part 1 The Doctor and Romana visit the Leisure Hive on Argolis. The Argolin, survivors of a war, run the Hive as a tourist attraction but its future is jeopardised by a series of deaths.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E2 The Leisure Hive: Part 2 The Tachyon Recreation Generator is the cause of the mysterious deaths at the Leisure Hive. Romana makes repairs, and the Doctor becomes a reluctant guinea pig.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E3 The Leisure Hive: Part 3 The Tachyon Generator has aged the Doctor into a white haired old man, but he discovers the truth behind the machine and uncovers a plot to take control of the Hive.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E4 The Leisure Hive: Part 4 The obsessed Pangol is determined to give Argolis a future with himself as the leader of the reborn race and plans to strike back at the Foamasi.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E5 Meglos: Part 1 On Zolfa-Thura, Meglos plans to steal the ancient and powerful Dodecahedron from the neighbouring world of Tigella. But first, the Doctor must be prevented from interfering.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E6 Meglos: Part 2 Masquerading as the Doctor, Meglos penetrates the underground city of Tigella. The Doctor and Romana are trapped in an ever repeating circle of time and powerless to act.

oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E09 Circle of Friends A teen is killed by a bullet during a party and his friend loses his freedom to what he says is a lie.

oxygenwest.us.title: New York Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E10 Abducted in Williamsburg In the midst of a blizzard, the abduction of a Hasidic man from his Williamsburg office sparks a desperate NYPD search; as more dark details emerge, discoveries of debts, betrayal and ties to the Russian mob send police on a mission for the truth.

oxygenwest.us.title: New York Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E11 Bronx Undercover When a college student goes missing, a search of her Bronx apartment leads the NYPD to suspect foul play; the investigation stalls until a witness comes forward, prompting an undercover sting operation that blows the lid off a deadly conspiracy.

oxygenwest.us.title: New York Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E12 Dangerous Work When prominent Latino journalist and activist Manuel de Dios Unanue is fatally shot at a Queens restaurant, a joint task force must figure out which of a long list of enemies, including some international terror groups, is behind his execution.

oxygenwest.us.title: Philly Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E08 Dungeons, Dragons, and Death The stabbing murder of a 20-year-old woman in the suburbs of Philadelphia stymies detectives until a series of eerily similar murders six years later reveals a killer that has been hiding in plain sight all along.

oxygenwest.us.title: Philly Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E09 Vanished in Plain Sight After a young mother mysteriously disappears, all of Philadelphia unites in their efforts to find her; but as police begin peeling away the layers of her life, they discover the truth behind what happened to her.

oxygenwest.us.title: Philly Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E10 Killer in the Shadows The violent murder of a young newlywed in the outskirts of Philadelphia confounds investigators for decades until the perseverance of detectives, combined with new technology, reveals her killer was closer than anyone anticipated.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E29 The Ranch Eduardo Valseca is taken hostage in an orchestrated abduction; Keith Morrison reflects on the family he spent years following; what happened to them might have destroyed many, but not the Valsecas.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E30 What Happened to Amy? For more than 30 years, Ohio investigators have searched for answers in the murder of 10-year-old Amy Mihaljevic; the details of the case still haunt Josh Mankiewicz and investigators, who ask for help solving the crime.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E31 The Secret of Spirit Lake An advocate for missing and murdered Indigenous women searches for answers in the disappearance of her niece and exposes cracks in law enforcement; Andrea Canning looks back on this important story, one that became her passion project.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E32 The Plan A double homicide in upstate New York leads detectives on a cross-country investigation; Dennis Murphy reflects on a story full of twists and turns, including the surprising suspect at the center.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E33 The Haunting The children of an Oklahoma pastor survive the robbery that took their parents' lives; it's a story Keith Morrison still can't forget, and one where the very best and worst of humanity are both on full display.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E34 Internal Affairs When a popular graduate student is shot dead in Durham, N.C., detectives uncover a deadly love triangle; it takes a lot to surprise correspondent Josh Mankiewicz, but the claims are shocking.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E35 Return to Manitowoc County It's a mystery that defies easy answers, and "Dateline" has been following it for more than a decade; Steven Avery and his teenage nephew were convicted of killing Teresa Halbach; now, Andrea Canning shares her insight into the controversial case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E36 Twisted When an Iowa woman is attacked while home alone with her three children, the confrontation turns deadly; Dennis Murphy examines one of the most sophisticated criminal plots of his "Dateline" career.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 A Deadly Thanksgiving A deranged shooter attacks a family Thanksgiving dinner, leaving four dead and even more wounded, setting off a massive holiday-season manhunt to catch the killer - before they can strike again.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E01 Thanks-killing Earl and Terry Robertson are found brutally murdered in their home just before Thanksgiving; investigating whether this is a holiday robbery gone terribly wrong, or a crime committed by someone the couple knew and trusted.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline

wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

fxm.us.title: The Song of Bernadette
fxm.us.description: Based on the popular novel by Franz Werfel, this drama focuses on Bernadette Soubirous (Jennifer Jones), a young French woman who experiences vivid visions of the Virgin Mary. While many dismiss her claims, certain people, including the priest Dominique Peyramale (Charles Bickford), slowly begin to believe her. Eventually, Bernadette is deemed a saint, and becomes a nun at a convent, where she must deal with jealousy from others who resent her revered status. (Drama) - 1943

fxm.us.title: The Lodger
fxm.us.description: In London in 1889, retiree Robert Burton (Cedric Hardwicke) and his wife, Ellen (Sara Allgood), rent a spare room to the mysterious Slade (Laird Cregar) as Jack the Ripper continues to terrorize the city. The Burtons' niece, Kitty (Merle Oberon), is a music hall singer who initially grows fond of the eccentric lodger, but, when the Ripper's body count rises, she and a Scotland Yard inspector (George Sanders) gradually begin to suspect that Slade could be the notorious Whitechapel killer. (Thriller) - 1944

fxm.us.title: Leave Her to Heaven
fxm.us.description: While on a train, writer Richard Harland (Cornel Wilde) strikes up a relationship with the gorgeous Ellen Berent (Gene Tierney). Ellen quickly becomes obsessed with Richard and abandons her fiancé, Russell Quinton (Vincent Price), to be with him. The couple rushes into marriage, with both of them caught up in romance and Richard intrigued by Ellen's intensity. Only after settling into marriage, however, does Richard realize that she is psychotically jealous and highly unstable. (Crime drama) - 1945

fxm.us.title: The Terrorists
fxm.us.description: Attempting to secure the release of political prisoners, a terrorist group, led by the fierce Ray Petrie (Ian McShane), takes over a British plane. Tough Scandinavian operative Nils Tahlvik (Sean Connery) is sent in to deal with the armed men and free the aircraft's passengers. Unfortunately for Tahlvik, the terrorists prove to be quite formidable. Meanwhile, another unit of the same extremist organization is holding an English ambassador hostage, which further complicates matters. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1974

fxm.us.title: Laura
fxm.us.description: In one of the most celebrated 1940s film noirs, Manhattan detective Mark McPherson (Dana Andrews) investigates the murder of Madison Avenue executive Laura Hunt (Gene Tierney) in her fashionable apartment. On the trail of her murderer, McPherson quizzes Laura's arrogant best friend, gossip columnist Waldo Lydecker (Clifton Webb) and her comparatively mild fiancé, Shelby Carpenter (Vincent Price). As the detective grows obsessed with the case, he finds himself falling in love with the dead woman. (Mystery) - 1944

fxm.us.title: Lucy in the Sky
fxm.us.description: After an awe-inspiring experience in outer space, an astronaut returns to Earth and starts to lose touch with reality in a world that now seems too small. (Drama) - 2019

fxm.us.title: Empire of Light
fxm.us.description: A romance develops in a beautiful old cinema on the south coast of England in the 1980s. (Romance, Drama) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Jojo Rabbit
fxm.us.description: Jojo is a lonely German boy who discovers that his single mother is hiding a Jewish girl in their attic. Aided only by his imaginary friend -- Adolf Hitler -- Jojo must confront his blind nationalism as World War II continues to rage on. (Comedy drama, Dark comedy) - 2019

fxm.us.title: High Anxiety
fxm.us.description: Just after becoming the director of the Psychoneurotic Institute for the Very, Very Nervous, Dr. Richard H. Thorndyke is greeted by a series of mysterious events. When his colleagues -- including the militaristic and mustachioed Nurse Diesel -- become leery of his questions, they accuse him of murder. Thorndyke's own mental health comes into question as he struggles to clear his name in the midst of a crippling bout of a condition known as high anxiety. (Comedy) - 1977

fxm.us.title: Wild on the Beach
fxm.us.description: Music and romance abound as two groups of college students fight for their right to party at a beach house. (Musical comedy) - 1965

fxm.us.title: Decision Before Dawn
fxm.us.description: During World War II, an American intelligence unit led by Col. Devlin (Gary Merrill) is recruiting German prisoners of war to infiltrate enemy lines and gather vital information. Lt. Rennick (Richard Basehart) heads a unit of Germans that includes the mistrustful "Tiger" (Hans Christian Blech) and the wide-eyed "Happy" (Oskar Werner). When word arrives that a German general is about to negotiate the surrender of his corps, Devlin sends Rennick and his volunteers on a dangerous mission. (Drama, War, Thriller) - 1951

fxm.us.title: Hell and High Water
fxm.us.description: Mercenary sub commander, Captain Adam Jones (Richard Widmark), sells his services to noted atomic scientist Professor Montel (Victor Francen) and his daughter, Denise (Bella Darvi). Professor Montel is convinced the Communists are about to launch a nuclear attack on Korea from an island in the Arctic and blame it on the United States. Captain Jones does not care about politics, but the earnest Professor and his supporters win him over to their cause, and they try to thwart the Communists' plans. (Adventure) - 1954

fxm.us.title: Nightmare Alley
fxm.us.description: Roustabout Stanton Carlisle joins a traveling carny and unsuccessfully schemes to figure out the mind-reading act of Mademoiselle Zeena and her alcoholic husband, Pete. But when Pete dies, Zeena is forced to take on Stanton as a partner, and he quickly proves more gifted than his predecessor. Ambitious to a fault, Carlisle abandons Zeena and the carny to reinvent himself as The Great Stanton, wowing high-class audiences in a Chicago hotel. (Crime drama) - 1947

fxm.us.title: The Fly
fxm.us.description: When scientist Andre Delambre (Al Hedison) tests his matter transporter on himself, an errant housefly makes its way into the transportation chamber, and things go horribly wrong. As a result, Delambre's head and arm are now that of the insect. Slowly losing himself to the fly, Delambre turns to his wife, Helene (Patricia Owens), for help. But when tragedy strikes, Delambre's brother (Vincent Price) and Inspector Charas (Herbert Marshall) are forced to pick up the investigation. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1958

fxm.us.title: The Innocents
fxm.us.description: Based on the Henry James story "The Turn of the Screw," a psychological thriller about a woman who takes a governess job for two orphans in a Victorian home. She begins to see what she believes are ghosts and suspects the children's bizarre behavior is the result of supernatural powers. (Horror) - 1961

fxm.us.title: The Invitation
fxm.us.description: After the death of her mother and having no other known relatives, Evie takes a DNA test and discovers a long-lost cousin she never knew she had. Invited by her newfound family to a lavish wedding in the English countryside, Evie's at first seduced by the sexy aristocratic host. However, she's soon thrust into a nightmare of survival as she uncovers twisted secrets about her family history and the unsettling intentions behind their sinful generosity. (Horror, Thriller) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Morbius
fxm.us.description: Dangerously ill with a rare blood disorder and determined to save others from the same fate, Dr. Morbius attempts a desperate gamble. While at first it seems to be a radical success, a darkness inside of him is soon unleashed. - 2022

fxm.us.title: Madame Web
fxm.us.description: Cassandra Webb is a New York City paramedic who starts to show signs of clairvoyance. Forced to confront revelations about her past, she must protect three young women from a mysterious adversary who wants them dead. - 2024

fxm.us.title: X-Men: Dark Phoenix
fxm.us.description: During a rescue mission, Jean Grey is hit by a cosmic force that makes her infinitely more powerful, but far more unstable. The X-Men must now unite to save her soul and battle aliens that want to utilize Grey's mysterious new abilities. - 2019

5starmax.us.title: Flashpoint
5starmax.us.description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963. (Action) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: Holla
5starmax.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (Horror) - 2006

5starmax.us.title: Repo Men
5starmax.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Blood Simple
5starmax.us.description: "Blood Simple" was the first feature film from Joel and Ethan Coen. This is the newly restored and re-edited director's cut of the film, introduced by Mortimer Young. The stylish crime thriller premiered at film festivals in 1984. "Blood Simple" begins deep in the heart of Texas, where a jealous saloon owner hires a cheap divorce detective to kill the saloon owner's younger wife and her bartender lover. But the detective gets a better idea. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
5starmax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
5starmax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

5starmax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
5starmax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

5starmax.us.title: Batman
5starmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Batman Returns
5starmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Batman Forever
5starmax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Batman & Robin
5starmax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

5starmax.us.title: Working Girls
5starmax.us.description: College graduate Molly (Louise Smith), trying to bankroll her own business, works as a high-priced New York City escort. As a lesbian, she's able to keep her emotional distance from the clients, who range from cynically exploitative to desperately needy. But her open ambition to rise above her current station rubs many of her coworkers the wrong way, especially the combative, street-smart Dawn (Amanda Goodwin) and the escort service's disdainful madam, Lucy (Ellen McElduff). (Drama) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
5starmax.us.description: Stressed by adolescence, 16-year-old Craig Gilner (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a mental-health clinic. Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protégé, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush. (Comedy drama) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
5starmax.us.description: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green, who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons. (Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Despicable Me
5starmax.us.description: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
5starmax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
5starmax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Hall Pass
5starmax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
5starmax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers

backstage.us.description: The Wash is an action-comedy starring Snoop Dogg and Dr. Dre. As mismatched roommates working at a car wash, they come together to rescue their boss (George Wallace) from a couple of first-time kidnappers. If they don't settle their differences and get Mr. Washington back, the good times at The Wash will soon come to an end. (Comedy) - 2001

backstage.us.description: When rival crook Johnny Amato (Vincent Curatola) hatches a plan to rob a card game run by mob lackey Markie (Ray Liotta), he picks a low-rent thug named Frankie (Scoot McNairy) to do the job. Frankie picks a less-than-ideal partner (Ben Mendelsohn) to help him, but despite their combined incompetence, they manage to make off with the mob's money. In retaliation, Markie's bosses hire Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), a mob enforcer, to eradicate those responsible. (Crime drama, Action) - 2012

While under the watchful eyes of Detective Brikowski (Stanley Tucci) and well-known assassin Goodkat (Bruce Willis), Slevin must quickly devise a plan to save his skin before his luck runs out. Meanwhile, his wife (Jessica Alba) wrestles with demons of her own while her husband suffers through his ordeal. (Thriller) - 2007

bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Eastern Europe The Hairy Bikers travel to the furthest corners of Europe, culminating in a fun family party thrown by Dave's Romanian wife, Lil.

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Austria The bikers tour the home of Mozart and Arnold Schwarzenegger, starting in the pâtisserie capital of the world, Vienna.

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Italy The bikers abandon their bikes in favor of gondolas and cook up focaccia, stromboli and eat a pasta pie on the backstreets of Ferrara.

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 France In Lyon, Dave and Si explore the 'bouchon', a restaurant normally run by a female chef.

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Spain Dave and Si journey through Spain and visit a traditional Basque dining club in San Sebastián.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Chocolate Chef Raymond Blanc creates four mouth-watering chocolate recipes: a simple mousse, rich chocolate delice, fondant with a melting middle, and his signature dessert: café crème, which is a chocolate-sculpted cup filled with a mousse and coffee sabayon.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Apples Chef Raymond Blanc looks to the UK's favorite fruit, apples, for inspiration; he returns to memories of childhood with a simple tart made with a foolproof pastry and custard filling.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Winter Vegetables Chef Blanc celebrates the season with a winter vegetable salad featuring beetroots, a celeriac purée served with a crisp-skinned roast wild duck with blackberry sauce and watercress soup.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Game and Mushrooms Chef Blanc uses two seasonal ingredients, game and mushrooms, to create a French version of a pasty called pithivier, which is filled with a rich mix of pheasant, chestnuts and dried fruits; he also makes a cep mushroom tortellini with fresh pasta.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Bread The miracle of yeast helps Raymond to create a French classic: brioche; he gets down to basics with a French country bread recipe that's essential for any baker to add to their repertoire; lastly, he makes a spectacular apple croustade.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Leftovers Nigel starts off with the remains of the Sunday roast.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Winter Warmers Nigel makes comfort foods that hit the spot.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E01 New Tricks Nigel transforms classic recipes with some new twists.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Too Good to Waste How to make simple, delicious feasts from ingredients that seem to have seen better days.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Nigella introduces her love of Italian food through a spectacular yet simple Sicilian pasta with tomatoes, garlic and almonds and a mid-week family feast of tagliata.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Nigella Lawson shares the secrets of her Italian roast chicken, served alongside a saffron orzotto; Nigella prepares coffee ice cream for dessert, inspired by the ice cream parlors of Florence; a chocolate olive oil cake provides an extra treat.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Episode 3 Pork loin stuffed with Parma ham and oregano, served alongside her speedy mock mash and lazy person's vignarola.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Liquorice pudding; Sardinian sun-dried and toasted couscous; butterflied leg of lamb; baby aubergines with oregano and roasted red onion.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Nigella starts with her take on a light and sunny yogurt pot cake; she recruits her niece and nephew to make a shortcut sausage meatball supper; Nigella prepares squid and prawns with marjoram and chili; a tiramisu ends the evening.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Episode 6 Lamb chops with mint; chilli and golden potatoes; ruby red plum and amoretti crumble; farro risotto with mushrooms.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E01 Shellfish Chef Blanc celebrates the best of British shellfish as he cooks dishes including Moules Marinière, seared squid salad and Scottish lobster.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E05 Charcuterie Chef Raymond shares his love of charcuterie, beginning with thin slices of duck cured in herbs and juniper berries; also, he makes a chicken liver parfait and a meaty pot-au-feu medley; lastly, a ham hock terrine served with home-made pickles.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E06 Spices and Chillies Drawing upon his travels through Asia, Raymond creates dishes full of fragrant spice and fiery heat.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E07 Summer Fruits Raymond demonstrates the versatility of the summer's juiciest fruits with a simple but impressive berry-strewn pavlova and a spicy cherry clafoutis where the vibrant fruit is cushioned in a bed of soft, sumptuous pastry.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E08 Summer Greens Raymond celebrates the freshest summer greens, beginning with a simple yet vibrant pistou soup, laden with summer vegetables and bursting with basil, topped with crispy croutons and meltingly rich Parmesan.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Nisha's family helps her cook chicken dhansak and a Hungarian favorite.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Nisha cooks chicken korma and marinated tandoori monkfish tail on the BBQ.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Nisha cooks a traditional monsoon mushroom curry with grapes and tasty barbecued corn.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Nisha Katona cooks salmon and tomato curry, and eggplant curry with fresh roti.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Nisha cooks oxtail and shin curry, spiced barbecued prawns and banana pudding.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Nisha cooks some Malaysian mussels and ginger biscuit lamb raan.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Nisha cooks meatball curry and tandoori chops with turmeric chips.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Nisha cooks egg and cauliflower curry and some Hungarian plum dumplings.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E09 Nisha cooks Bengali fish in banana leaves and a big roasted rib of beef.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E10 Nisha cooks chicken and apricot biryani and fish finger sandwiches.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Suffolk and Naples Rick celebrates the abundance of seafood and the rich, colorful sauces of Naples.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 India and Cornwall Rick catches turbot off the Cornish coast and cooks it with cider and cream.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Spain and Britain Rick's off to Galicia in Spain to sample some rare shellfish.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 India and America A spicy shark vindaloo and the making of an authentic dhal with lentils.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Australia and Italy Seafood king Rick travels to Queensland, Australia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 America and Cornwall Chesapeake Bay in the U.S., cooking traditional oyster dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Thailand and Cornwall Rick goes to Hua Hin in Thailand, where he spends time in local markets talking to locals about various types of food; in Cornwall, he fries fish and jazzes it up with red curry and steamed jasmine rice.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 America and Yorkshire Rick visits America, Naples and the UK in Whitby, with good old English fish and chips in the final episode.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Sweet and Sour Nigel Slater shows us how to prepare five different sweet and sour dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Fish and Meat Nigel continues to explore successful food marriages in the kitchen.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Spicy and Cool Nigel Slater shows us how to mix spicy flavors with something cooling.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Soft and Crisp Nigel Slater continues his exploration of brilliant culinary combinations.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Sugar and Spice Nigel shows a classic cinnamon, ginger and plum cake and demonstrates the unexpected such as sticky ribs and a spicy lentil stew with caramelized onions.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Born and Bred Nigel transforms everyday suppers, including a dish of baked mushrooms and chestnuts and a home-grown pud of blackberry and fig pie.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Kolkata and Chennai Rick explores Bengal and Tamil Nadu, the regions that began Britain's love affair with curry; Rick enjoys the prominence of fish and seafood in their dishes, flavored with mustard in Kolkata and tamarind in Chennai.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Mumbai and Pondicherry Rick explores Mumbai in search of the bombil, the fish that immortalized Bombay Duck; enjoying Parsee hospitality.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Lucknow and Punjab Rick Stein arrives in the cultural city of Lucknow, India; it is reputed to be the curry capital of India.
