buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

cinesony.us.description: Dos jóvenes marinos son acusados de asesinar a un compañero. La defensa es otorgada al teniente Kaffee, más interesado en el béisbol que en derecho, y a la diligente teniente Galloway, quien llegará para cambiar rotundamente la visión del asesinato. (Movies, Drama) - 1992

cinevault.us.title: Agnes of God
cinevault.us.description: Dr. Martha Livingston (Jane Fonda) is a court-appointed psychiatrist sent to evaluate Sister Agnes (Meg Tilly), a young nun whose infant has been found strangled. With Agnes claiming a virgin conception and having no memory of giving birth, Livingston must distinguish between the lies and the nun's perception-altering faith. Complicating her investigation, Livingston continually clashes with the overbearing Mother Miriam Ruth (Anne Bancroft), who insists that Livingston leave Agnes alone. (Drama, Movie) - 1985-09-13

cinevault.us.title: Touch the Top of the World
cinevault.us.description: Climber Erik Weihenmayer becomes the first blind person to reach the summit of Mount Everest. (Docudrama, Movie) - 2006-06-11

cinevault.us.title: Buddy
cinevault.us.description: Thanks to the indulgence of her patient husband, Dr. Bill Lintz, wealthy eccentric Trudy has already accumulated a large collection of wild animals by 1931 when she is introduced to Buddy, a sickly young gorilla. Trudy raises Buddy as her own child, dressing him in human clothes, and the ape responds with absolute obedience. But as Buddy grows older and larger, Trudy is unable to restrain him from turning increasingly violent. (Adventure, Children, Comedy drama, Movie) - 1997-06-06

cinevault.us.title: The Master of Disguise
cinevault.us.description: Pistachio Disguisey, a genial waiter at his father Fabrizio's Italian restaurant, possesses an uncanny knack for mimicry. What he doesn't know is that his talent is genetic, and that he is the descendant of a long line of Masters of Disguise, all of whom have inherited the secret family gift known as Energico. Initially, Pistachio is a klutz, but little by little, he learns to harness his inherited power, and sallies forth to utilize Energico to its fullest. (Comedy, Movie) - 2002-08-02

cinevault.us.title: Sunset
cinevault.us.description: Having retired from a life of gunfights and peacekeeping, the great Wyatt Earp (James Garner) has landed a job as adviser to a Western movie about himself. On the set of the silent picture, he gets to know Tom Mix (Bruce Willis), an actor who specializes in Westerns, who has been hired to portray Earp. Not long after making each others' acquaintance, they find out that Earp's ex-girlfriend's son is missing, and the man responsible may be studio chief Alfie Alperin (Malcolm McDowell). (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1988-04-29

cinevault.us.title: Conspiracy
cinevault.us.description: A former Marine (Val Kilmer) brings justice to a small town after his friend mysteriously disappears. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2008-02-15

cinevault.us.title: No Mercy
cinevault.us.description: After his partner is killed by the merciless crime boss Losado, Chicago cop Eddie Jillette takes to New Orleans to settle the score. When he finds Losado's mistress, Michel, Eddie handcuffs himself to the girl and heads for the bayou in an effort to draw out his rival. And though squatting in a swamp handcuffed to another person is no recipe for romance, Eddie and Michel soon find themselves falling in love even as Losado is closing in. (Crime drama, Movie) - 1986-12-19

cinevault.us.title: The Principal
cinevault.us.description: The new principal (James Belushi) of a drug-infested high school joins with a security guard (Louis Gossett Jr.) to clean it up. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1987

cinevault.us.title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
cinevault.us.description: Following a childhood tragedy, Dewey Cox (John C. Reilly) follows a long and winding road to music stardom. Dewey perseveres through changing musical styles, an addiction to nearly every drug known and bouts of uncontrollable rage, until finally, he wins the heart, but not necessarily the body, of his loyal backup singer, Darlene (Jenna Fischer). (Comedy, Movie, Musical comedy) - 2007

cinevault.us.title: Julie & Julia
cinevault.us.description: Frustrated with a soul-killing job, New Yorker Julie Powell embarks on a daring project: she vows to prepare all 524 recipes in Julia Child's landmark cookbook, "Mastering the Art of French Cooking." Intertwined with Julie's story is the true tale of how Julia Child herself conquered French cuisine with passion, fearlessness, and plenty of butter. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 2009-08-07

cinevault.us.title: Crossroads
cinevault.us.description: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson. (Drama, Movie, Music, Romance) - 1986

cinevault.us.title: Fire on the Mountain
cinevault.us.description: A developer (Ron Howard) helps an old rancher (Buddy Ebsen) defend land the Army wants for a missile base. (Drama, Movie) - 1981-11-23

cinevault.us.title: Bless Me, Ultima
cinevault.us.description: A young man and an elderly medicine woman try to end the battle between good and evil that is waging out of control through their village during World War II. (Drama, Movie, War) - 2012

cinevault.us.title: The Waterdance
cinevault.us.description: Injured in a climbing accident, writer Joel Garcia (Eric Stoltz) wakes up in a hospital having lost the use of his legs. Soon after, he's placed in a recovery ward where he begins the arduous process of rehabilitation and meets others with injuries like his own. Raymond (Wesley Snipes) is a ladies' man whose girl has nevertheless split, and Bloss (William Forsythe) is a rather prejudiced biker. Together, this unlikely trio helps one another to overcome the greatest challenge of their lives. (Drama, Movie) - 1992

cinevault.us.title: Raising Waylon
cinevault.us.description: A restaurateur (Thomas Gibson) and a photographer (Poppy Montgomery) learn surprising things about themselves while taking care of their 9-year-old godchild. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2004-02-22

cinevault.us.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
cinevault.us.description: A scientist (Jeffrey Nordling) and his team fly down a volcano and become lost in an inner world of chaos and wonders. (Movie, Science fiction) - 1993-02-28

cinevault.us.title: 3 Ninjas: High Noon at Mega Mountain
cinevault.us.description: Ninja brothers Colt (Michael J. O'Laskey II), Rocky (Mathew Botuchis) and Tum Tum (Victor Wong) go to an amusement park to get a glimpse of their idol, action star Dave Dragon (Hulk Hogan). But when evil masterminds Medusa (Loni Anderson) and Lothar Zogg (Jim Varney) descend on the park, the boys are thrust into a real-life shoot-'em-up. Now they must use their martial-arts training to defend the park's helpless guests -- getting a little assistance from their longtime hero. (Action, Movie) - 1998-04-10

cinevault.us.title: 3 Ninjas Knuckle Up
cinevault.us.description: During their summer vacation, Rocky, Colt and Tum Tum visit their grandfather, who is training them to be martial arts masters. They soon befriend Jo, a Native American girl who lives nearby. When Jo's father goes missing, the boys realize this may be connected to revelations that a high-profile businessman has been secretly dumping noxious waste in a sacred burial ground. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Movie) - 1995-03-10

cinevault.us.title: Brian's Song
cinevault.us.description: Although they both play for the Chicago Bears, Brian Piccolo (Sean Maher) is white, a joker and mostly rides the bench while Gale Sayers (Mekhi Phifer) is black, serious and a rookie superstar. Neither likes the other much, but when coach Halas (Ben Gazzara) makes them the first interracial roommates in the NFL, the two gradually form a sincere friendship. Piccolo helps Sayers overcome an injury, and Sayers later gives Piccolo much needed support when he's diagnosed with terminal cancer. (Docudrama, Movie) - 2001-12-02

cinevault.us.title: Murphy's Romance
cinevault.us.description: Emma (Sally Field), a divorced single mother seeking to start her life over, moves to a small town in Arizona. She builds a relationship with Murphy (James Garner), the older local pharmacist but, due to his age, it remains platonic. Their friendship becomes complicated when Emma's ex-husband, Bobby Jack (Brian Kerwin), shows up. He claims to have changed his ways, but when he turns out to be the same man Emma divorced, she discovers her true feelings for Murphy. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 1985

cinevault.us.title: Guarding Tess
cinevault.us.description: Doug Chesnic (Nicolas Cage), an agent with the Secret Service Uniformed Division, is assigned to protect former first lady Tess Carlisle (Shirley MacLaine). Chesnic finds the job demeaning and a challenge because of Tess' high-maintenance personality and petty demands. He's desperate to get another assignment, but she insists that he remain head of her security detail, using her influence with the current president to get her way. When she's kidnapped, however, Chesnic's feelings change. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1994-04-30

circlecountry.us.title: McLintock!
circlecountry.us.description: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter. (Western, Comedy) - 1963

circlecountry.us.title: Rage at Dawn
circlecountry.us.description: Private detective James Barlow (Randolph Scott) is sent to Indiana to infiltrate the ranks of the four Reno Brothers (Denver Pyle, Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Myron Healy), a gang running roughshod over luckless locals. After attracting the Renos' attention with a staged train robbery, Barlow gets in deeper when he strikes up a romance with their sister, Laura (Mala Powers). Gradually, Barlow devises a strategy to set the brothers up for ambush in another train robbery. (Western) - 1955

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - Blood on the Land
circlecountry.us.description: Jeb Drummond is a murderous sheep herder who has Adam taken hostage to try and force Ben to sign over a large section of Ponderosa land to him. (Drama, Western) - 1960-02-13

circlecountry.us.title: Blue Collar Comedy Tour: One for the Road

circlecountry.us.title: Blue Collar Comedy Tour: The Movie
circlecountry.us.description: The all-stars of Southern comedy collaborate in this uproarious live stand-up experience. In the summer of 2002, Jeff Foxworthy, Bill Engvall, Ron White and Larry the Cable Guy barnstorm the country with their unique brand of working-class humor. This film documenting the tour captures the highlights of the comedians' hilarious acts, while also going behind the scenes to give viewers a candid look at each of these irrepressible comic personalities. (Documentary) - 2003

circlecountry.us.title: The Quick and the Dead
circlecountry.us.description: A mysterious woman gunslinger, Ellen (Sharon Stone), saunters into the town of Redemption looking for revenge. Her father was killed by the town's sadistic mayor, Herod (Gene Hackman), who is in the midst of organizing a quick-draw tournament. The lady enters, joining a cast of miscreants and outlaws for a brutal competition in which the loser dies. Among the competitors is "The Kid" (Leonardo DiCaprio), an upstart who has his own score to settle with Herod. (Western, Action) - 1995

circlecountry.us.title: Stagecoach
circlecountry.us.description: John Ford's landmark Western revolves around an assorted group of colorful passengers aboard the Overland stagecoach bound for Lordsburg, New Mexico, in the 1880s. An alcoholic philosophizer (Thomas Mitchell), a lady of ill repute (Claire Trevor) and a timid liquor salesman (Donald Meek) are among the motley crew of travelers who must contend with an escaped outlaw, the Ringo Kid (John Wayne), and the ever-present threat of an Apache attack as they make their way across the Wild West. (Western) - 1939

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: The Contract
filmriseaction.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: Dillinger and Capone
filmriseaction.us.description: Dillinger's (Martin Sheen) reported 1934 death gives him a new life, but Chicago mobster Capone (F. Murray Abraham) wants him to pull one more heist. (Historical drama) - 1995

filmriseaction.us.title: Guns of Redemption
filmriseaction.us.description: Searching for redemption, a mysterious gunslinger with a violent past tries to save a young woman from vicious men who run a traveling brothel. (Western, Action) - 2025

filmriseaction.us.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
filmriseaction.us.description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town. (Western) - 2023

filmriseaction.us.title: Blitz
filmriseaction.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2011

filmriseaction.us.title: The 51st State
filmriseaction.us.description: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American. (Action, Comedy) - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Survivor
filmriseaction.us.description: Framed for a terrorist bombing, a foreign service officer (Milla Jovovich) must dodge a top assassin (Pierce Brosnan), while racing against time to thwart a deadly plot. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell
filmriseaction.us.description: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity. (Action) - 2003

filmriseaction.us.title: Stolen
filmriseaction.us.description: A former thief (Nicolas Cage) has just 12 hours to come up with $10 million after his former partner (Josh Lucas) kidnaps his daughter and locks her in a cab. (Action, Thriller) - 2012

filmriseaction.us.title: If... Dog... Rabbit
filmriseaction.us.description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother. (Drama) - 1998

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: The Final Stand
filmriseaction.us.description: The story of the Podolsk cadets in October 1941 near Moscow during WWII, where the cadets of the Podolsk artillery-infantry schools receive orders to take up defenses on the Ilyinsky line. (Action, Drama, War) - 2020

filmriseaction.us.title: Agent Red

filmriseaction.us.title: Derailed
filmriseaction.us.description: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus. (Action, Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: American Yakuza

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Code

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond. (Drama, Fantasy, War) - 1999

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2004

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Long Walk Home
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better. (Historical drama) - 1990

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Cold Blood

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Straight A's

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: I'm Charlie Walker
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him. (Drama) - 2022

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Jack's Back
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mysteria
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Aleister Bain (Robert Miano), a whiskey-soaked and washed-up Hollywood screenwriter, desperately struggles to finish a script. (Mystery) - 2011

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Getaway
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive. (Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1994

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Eye See You
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hit & Run
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down. (Comedy, Action, Adventure) - 2012

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Are You Here
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After his eccentric pal (Zach Galifianakis) inherits a fortune from his estranged father, an aimless, womanizing weatherman (Owen Wilson) becomes involved in the legal battle initiated by his friend's sister (Amy Poehler). (Comedy drama) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Just Getting Started
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them. (Drama) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Honest Thief
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice. (Action, Thriller) - 2020

hdnetmovies.us.title: The Great Escape
hdnetmovies.us.description: Imprisoned during World War II in a German POW camp, a group of Allied soldiers are intent on breaking out, not only to escape, but also to draw Nazi forces away from battle to search for fugitives. Among the prisoners determined to escape are American Captain Virgil Hilts and British Squadron Leader Roger Bartlett. Outwitting their captors by digging a tunnel out of the prison grounds, the soldiers find the stakes much higher when escape becomes a reality. (War, Drama) - 1963

hdnetmovies.us.title: Comes a Horseman
hdnetmovies.us.description: Determined single woman Ella Connors (Jane Fonda) struggles to maintain her ranch despite constant attempts by Jacob "J.W." Ewing (Jason Robards), the aging owner of the neighboring ranch, to coerce her into selling. When oil companies begin pressuring both ranchers to allow drilling, Ella's position becomes even more perilous. Though Ella thinks she's scrappy enough to fight them on her own, her chances get better with the arrival of hunky war veteran Frank "Buck" Athearn (James Caan). (Western) - 1978

hdnetmovies.us.title: Ride in the Whirlwind
hdnetmovies.us.description: Cowboys Wes (Jack Nicholson), Vern (Cameron Mitchell) and Otis (Tom Filer) are journeying through Texas when they have the unfortunate luck of meeting a gang of robbers who have just held up a stagecoach and lynched the driver. The local sheriff's posse surrounds them before they can get away, and Wes and his friends are unable to convince the lawmen they're not part of the gang. After a fierce shootout, Wes and Vern flee -- with the vigilante sheriff hot on their trail. (Western) - 1965

hdnetmovies.us.title: Support Your Local Sheriff
hdnetmovies.us.description: A small-scale gold rush erupts in a Colorado town after treasure is found in a grave. The area quickly becomes a magnet for criminals and other ne'er-do-wells, but everyone is too intent on searching for gold to consider law and order. When Jason McCullough (James Garner), a clever and supremely laid-back gunslinger, wanders into town, he becomes the de facto lawman, aided by local eccentric Jake (Jack Elam). McCullough's ingenuity is tested, however, when he runs afoul of the tough Danby gang. (Western, Comedy) - 1969

hdnetmovies.us.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
hdnetmovies.us.description: When traveling con man Latigo Smith (James Garner) drifts into a small Western town, he decides to take advantage of a local rivalry between gold-mining factions. Recruiting the shifty Jug May (Jack Elam) to pose as a notorious gunfighter, Smith sets his scheme in motion, while also taking time to romance the lovely Patience Barton (Suzanne Pleshette). However, after his ruse is uncovered, Smith incurs the wrath of the real hired gun, among others, leading to a big shoot-out. (Western, Comedy) - 1971

hdnetmovies.us.title: Sam Whiskey
hdnetmovies.us.description: Great gambler Sam Whiskey (Burt Reynolds) has got his hands on a heist job that's pretty outrageous, even by Wild West standards. A drop-dead-gorgeous woman (Angie Dickinson) wants to quietly give back the gold her husband had stolen, now that he's dead. She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal. (Western, Comedy) - 1969

hdnetmovies.us.title: Battle of Britain

Within months, the Nazis find themselves on the run, thanks to Dowding's tactical genius and the work of talented squadron leaders (Michael Caine, Christopher Plummer) and other brave patriots. (War, Action, Drama) - 1969

The two men fight, and when Quigley is knocked out, Marston leaves him and a local crazy woman (Laura San Giacomo) to die in a remote part of the Outback. hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E08 Bottle-ottle-ottle Off to find more wild homes, Jack climbs up to a treetop oasis made from salvaged materials; then, he tours a property made out of glass bottles and visits a 19th century home that turned three structures into one unexpected residence.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E09 Triple Threat Jack's wild search takes him to a triple geodesic dome home created by the owner and a suburban house designed top to bottom with marble; he visits a newly-purchased Arizona ghost town to discover how the owners plan to bring it back to life.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E10 Let's Get It Tron Jack finds a Dallas home for sale inspired by sci-fi movies plus another in Taos, New Mexico, known as the Adobe Castle that doubles as an art museum; he also visits an earth home bought by a woman who drove 15 hours to make an offer on it.

hgtvwest.us.title: Roast My Rental
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E04 Lost in Space Leslie's disappointed after checking in at a Joshua Tree spaceship desert escape; broken furniture and a theme that's lost in space leave Jasmine with her hardest project yet.

hgtvwest.us.title: Roast My Rental
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E08 Star-Quality Studio In Los Angeles, Leslie finds herself in a garage studio that's more crash pad than Hollywood glamor; with fake bamboo and old, bulky furnishings, this rental needs a head-to-toe redesign from Jasmine to make it an elegant rental fit for a celebrity.

hgtvwest.us.title: Roast My Rental
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E11 Suites or Sheds!? What the shed?! In Topanga, California, wall-to-wall disappointment awaits Leslie and Jasmine as they contend with cramped spaces, poor design and an unfinished bathroom.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S17 E01 Hot Springs Party Palace After receiving an inheritance, a mother and son look to honor a loved one with the vacation party palace he always wanted in Hot Springs, Ark.; David arrives to search for lake front properties big enough to accommodate a family.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S12 E05 Second Chance Lottery After a close call with a motorcycle accident, a New York couple credits "My Lottery Dream Home" marathons as their motivation to get through rehabilitation; David is happy to help them find their own dream home in sunny St. Augustine, Fla.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S13 E11 Texas Tranquility After an unexpected inheritance, a woman is finally able to buy a home near her daughter and grandchildren; She wants a house that's no more than ten minutes away from her family.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S16 E02 Gold Lady of Lake Mendota A Wisconsin woman doesn't hit the lottery, but she hits the jackpot with a savvy investment that pays off to the tune of eight figures; David has the largest budget he's ever been given and looks to find her the ultimate lakefront mega-mansion.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S13 E07 First-Time Homeowners, First-Time Millionaires! A young couple wins big and are ready to start building a life together and find a first home they can renovate; David arrives with plenty of ideas and helps explore options in the picturesque town of Rochester, N.Y.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S17 E12 Ozark Lake House After winning a hefty $250,000 on a scratcher, David helps a couple find their dream lake house in the Missouri Ozarks!

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Quarry
network.us.description: A tip leads Benson and Cragen to the body of a 7-year-old boy, missing since 1980, and the detectives think the new information was a ploy to help the suspected killer, on death row for another murder, delay his execution. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Game
network.us.description: Stabler and Fin investigate the brutal rape and murder of a prostitute, and the prime suspects turn out to be a group of teens suspected of re-enacting a favorite video game. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Hooked
network.us.description: The detectives discover that a murdered teenage girl was a prostitute and had contracted HIV while working on a pornographic film, which leads them to her killer. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Ghost
network.us.description: When a wealthy couple laundering money for South American drug dealers is murdered, former ADA Alexandra Cabot (Stephanie March) returns from witness protection to help solve the case. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Design
network.us.description: A distraught pregnant woman threatens suicide, claiming that her child is a product of rape, but when the case goes to trial, the woman's willingness to settle for cash makes detectives suspicious. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Blast
network.us.description: When an 8-year-old girl is kidnapped on her way home from school, DNA tests on the blood found in the abductor's abandoned van reveal she has leukemia. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Taboo
network.us.description: When a baby boy is discovered in the trash, Benson and Stabler use a bar T-shirt found at the scene to link the crime to a well-to-do college student. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Fat
network.us.description: A band of overweight teenage siblings attacks a gifted piano student from Harlem. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Informed
network.us.description: Detective Benson goes undercover to combat terrorist activities; a victim refuses a rape kit. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Clock
network.us.description: Stabler and Fin investigate the disappearance of two high-school students from a museum field-trip; Stabler meets his new partner. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Recall
network.us.description: Stabler and Beck (Connie Nielsen) are unable to build a case against a rape suspect until a new witness (Leslie Caron) steps forward. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Confrontation
network.us.description: When an assailant rapes his victim twice, detectives Stabler and Beck (Connie Nielsen) link the case to other victims of multiple rapes. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Underbelly
network.us.description: Stabler and Beck (Connie Nielsen) try to get a young prostitute to testify against her pimp (Michael Kenneth Williams) after a trio of murder victims with matching tattoos leads them to a teenage prostitution ring. (Drama)

retroplex.us.title: Romance of the West
retroplex.us.description: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), along with his sidekick, Ezra (Emmett Lynn), oversees the peaceful coexistence of the Native American tribes with the white settlers of Antelope Valley. The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Border Feud
retroplex.us.description: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Paradise Canyon
retroplex.us.description: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns). (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
retroplex.us.description: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars
retroplex.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Jericho
retroplex.us.description: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho. (Western, Mystery) - 2000

retroplex.us.title: Chappaquiddick
retroplex.us.description: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious events forever alters his political legacy and changes the course of presidential history. (Thriller, Historical drama) - 2017

retroplex.us.title: Niagara Niagara
retroplex.us.description: Two misfits (Robin Tunney, Henry Thomas) meet while shoplifting and set out on a mission that takes a quick downward spiral. (Drama) - 1997

retroplex.us.title: Double Whammy
retroplex.us.description: Ray Pluto (Denis Leary) has many problems. He is satirized in the tabloids as the "loser cop." His partner (Steve Buscemi) is starting to seem suspiciously attracted to him. A pair of screenwriters (Donald Faison, Keith Nobbs) across the hall keep bugging him for help. The superintendent of his building (Luis Guzmán) is stabbed by hoodlums hired by his own rebellious daughter (Melonie Diaz). To top it off, a sexually aggressive chiropractor (Elizabeth Hurley) may just be Ray's undoing. (Comedy) - 2001

retroplex.us.title: Live!
retroplex.us.description: Documentarian Rex (David Krumholtz) follows ruthless reality television producer Katy Courbet (Eva Mendes), a woman who will stop at nothing to revive the American Broadcasting Network's failing ratings -- and forward her own career. To the dismay of the government, Courbet approves a reality show that will become network television's first foray into snuff. In the first episode, contestants engage in a deadly game of Russian roulette for the chance at a multi-million-dollar cash prize. (Comedy drama) - 2007

retroplex.us.title: After Dark, My Sweet
retroplex.us.description: After escaping from a mental hospital, drifting ex-boxer Kid Collie (Jason Patric) meets an alcoholic widow, Fay (Rachel Ward), who entices him into performing maintenance work at her estate. When crooked Uncle Bud (Bruce Dern) joins the two, Fay's darker side begins to appear. Bud and Fay concoct a scheme to kidnap the son of a local wealthy family and have Collie carry out the dirty work, to which the troubled ex-boxer agrees, but he soon has second thoughts. (Crime drama) - 1990

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Mysteries From Above - Ancient Civilizations
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Decoding the secrets of long-lost human settlements; scrutinizing a mysterious Norwegian mound, a prehistoric stone circle on the banks of the Tagus River, a lost city in the cradle of civilization and bizarre rock shapes.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Extreme Weather Salvage - Salvage 911
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Capt. John Ward and his crew are called to raise a sunken houseboat near Pensacola, Fla.; the owner of the boat wants it back, but the current occupiers of the boat living in it don't want John's services; there've been reports of gunfire too.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: World's Most Scenic River Journeys - River Dordogne, France
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Traveling the Dordogne River via traditional boats through the green heart of southwest France; drinking wine and hunting for truffles; riding a luxury cruiser to a lighthouse built for a king.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Mysteries From Above - Ancient Civilizations
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Decoding the secrets of long-lost human settlements; scrutinizing a mysterious Norwegian mound, a prehistoric stone circle on the banks of the Tagus River, a lost city in the cradle of civilization and bizarre rock shapes.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Extreme Weather Salvage - Salvage 911
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Capt. John Ward and his crew are called to raise a sunken houseboat near Pensacola, Fla.; the owner of the boat wants it back, but the current occupiers of the boat living in it don't want John's services; there've been reports of gunfire too.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: How Did They Build That? - Curved & Cables
smithsonianchannel.us.description: A new performance center with a tent-like glass-and-steel lobby tests engineers in Kansas City; two twisting apartment towers make heads spin in Ontario.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: How Did They Fix That? - Powerships
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Mike Davidson heads to Brazil, where an offshore crew is racing the clock to set up giant power ships to deliver electricity to a country in desperate need.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Planes That Changed History - Nighthawk
smithsonianchannel.us.description: In 1981, the F-117 Nighthawk became the world's first stealth aircraft; explore how its futuristic design made this unconventional aircraft all but invisible to radar; a decade after its inception, the Nighthawk was put to the test in the Gulf War.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska - Fuel's Gold
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Father-son aviators battle turbulence to refuel a remote mine, bush pilots fight an aerial jam to reach Alaska's biggest sled race, and the Coastguard turn a C-130 into a bomber to drop supplies on an isolated beach.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Aerial Australia - The Vast West
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Western Australia is home to colossal gold mines, massive sheep stations, the world's largest shark, a 4x4 trail; it has Perth, the most isolated big city on Earth.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Mummy Mysteries - Killing a King
smithsonianchannel.us.description: The pockmarked mummy of Ramesses V reveals a shocking tale of bitter family infighting, a civil insurrection and a cause of death that ultimately pushed ancient Egypt to the edge of collapse.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Ancient Powers - Law and Order
smithsonianchannel.us.description: In an unruly world, ancient powers must lead their people and quash any rebellion; to achieve this, they may invent caste systems and more.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece - Secrets of the Acropolis
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Experts uncover the secrets of the Parthenon and of ancient Athens.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Scanning History - The Fall of the World's First Empire
smithsonianchannel.us.description: The first great empire of the Akkadians, led by Sargon the Great, dominated the Fertile Crescent, replacing the Sumerians and extending its influence as far north as Syria and south as Oman.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Treasures Decoded - Rome's Secret Weapon
smithsonianchannel.us.description: An archaeological investigation of an ancient Scottish battlefield uncovers a vast array of ballistic weaponry; x-ray scans reveal it came from a secret weapon called a manuballista, the Roman Empire's equivalent of an assault rifle. (Documentary, History) - 2021-08-16

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Disaster: The Chernobyl Meltdown - Cover Up ᴺᵉʷ
smithsonianchannel.us.description: The day after the incident, helicopter crews brave deadly radioactive smoke to extinguish the fire raging in the reactor core; as 50,000 locals evacuate, Soviet authorities try to conceal the scale and human cost of the accident. (Documentary) - 2026-04-25

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S12E09 Deadly Go Round When an A300 stalls and crashes just before landing in Japan, fears arise about the plane's complex automated systems. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S08E02 Testing the Limits On 26 May 1991, the thrust reverser on the number one engine of Lauda Air Flight 004 deploys in flight without being commanded, causing the aircraft to spiral out of control, disintegrate, and crash about 100 miles northwest of Bangkok. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E03 Hidden Figures Stories of historic Black struggle for equality in maritime combat; an enslaved powder boy who served during the French and Indian War; a Civil War gunner; the first African American to command a vessel with a fully integrated crew: Hugh Mulzac. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E07 Record Breakers A look at how technological advances over the centuries have led to bigger and faster combat ships and transformed maritime warfare. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E04 Gulf War Warriors A look at key naval battles that have taken place in the Persian Gulf over the last 50 years and the warships involved, from both sides of the conflicts. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E08 The Smallest Ships A look at the smallest ships of war and the major roles they've played over the centuries, including the 1776 gunboat built to stop a British invasion and the HA-19 sub. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E05 Sunk New high-tech investigations uncover what sunk a World War I cruiser, a World War II submarine, a British destroyer from the Falklands War, and more. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E06 Top Guns A look at how navy weapons have evolved over the centuries, from cannons to gun turrets to nuclear missiles and beyond. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E01 Courageous Captains Exploring maritime heroes who left their mark on history through their bravery and skill, including Larry Chambers, Ernest Evans, and Robert Smalls. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E08 River Raiders A look at riverine warfare from the Civil War to Vietnam and small but powerful combat ships. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E07 The Battle of Leyte Gulf It is considered the largest sea battle in history: the Battle of Leyte Gulf in WWII was three days of ingenious strategy and white-knuckle combat between warships, aircraft and kamikazes. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E03 The Battle of Incheon A portrayal of a crucial September 1950 military operation that helped the UN and ROK gain the upper hand over North Korea in the Korean War. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S09E02 Tornado An inside look at the Panavia Tornado's evolution from a Cold War low-level bomber to a high-level fighter-interceptor. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S09E01 Lancaster The inside story of the Avro Lancaster, the British bomber that was rushed into service to fight back against Nazi Germany. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S10E03 B-17 Flying Fortress The Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress is one of the most lethal bombers of the U.S. Air Force in WWII's European and Pacific campaigns; among other things, the plane delivered food to the German-occupied Netherlands. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S10E09 Stuka Dive Bomber A look at the rise and fall of the infamous Nazi dive bomber Ju-87 Stuka, an aircraft of World War II. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S06E08 Spitfire The Spitfire, the iconic aircraft of the Battle of Britain, will forever be remembered by a grateful nation and the dwindling numbers of pilots who flew her; it is still regarded as one of the best planes ever built. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S31 E25 Roxbury: Looking Back and Looking Ahead Angelo McRae shows Kevin how to install meshed white subway tiles for the kitchen backsplash; Kevin visits our Washington, D.C. project house; Tom Silva lends a hand with customizing and installing the stair treads and newel post for the new stairs.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S31 E26 Roxbury: One Less Foreclosure in Boston The job nears completion thanks to the dedication of general contractor David Lopes; Norm Abram and David reflect on how far the house has come in eight months; the team gathers for the wrap party.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E02 Auburndale: Regulations and Challenges Removing old yews; demolishing a sun porch; a visit to the estate's original gatehouse; progress on excavation out front and back; a team of concrete cutters cuts through 10-inch-thick concrete foundation walls.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E03 Auburndale: Bringing in the Structure A crane lifts a steel beam that will carry the load of the house; insulated concrete forms for the foundations and above-grade walls on the additions; pouring the foundation and walls; lead laws; the kitchen is gutted; the dining room wall goes down.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E04 Auburndale: Fixes, Framing, and Floods Framing the new mudroom and powder room on the first floor; contending with a termite-damaged sill in front; an eco-friendly plan to address the termites and carpenter ants.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E05 Auburndale: A New Approach to the House New front entry; framed-up kitchen; Tom turns the flat roof into a pitched one with prefabricated trusses; kitchen layout; Roger shows Kevin the native and non-native species taking over the flood plain; the layout for the new back deck and walkways.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E06 Auburndale: The Artistry of TOH and Jules Aarons Framing a slightly pitched roof over a new sunroom; tapering LVLs; roof rafters; installing deck underlayment; an expensive change order in a bathroom; a former resident of the home was street photographer Jules Aarons; back-to-back bathrooms.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E07 Auburndale: Progress On All Levels Richard finishes up installation of the floor-warming radiant heat under the new family room; a new basement floor and footings are poured, smoothed and leveled; Tom installs the new energy efficient, vinyl clad casement windows.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E09 Auburndale: Stucco, Kitchen Design, Roof, and Insulation Work on the exterior is progressing; using an acrylic stucco system in the basement; waterproofing the valley where the flat roof meets the pitched roof of the new entry addition; installing four different kinds of insulation throughout the house.

classica.us.title: Bach - 3. Sonate für Violin (BWV 1005)
classica.us.description: Isabelle Faust spielt zwei unglaubliche Solowerke für Violine von J. S. Bach: Partita Nr. 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 und Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. Beide Werke sind Teil der bekannten Sonaten und Solo-Partiten für Violine des Komponisten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 8
classica.us.description: Mahlers 8. Symphonie, auch bekannt als die Symphonie der Tausend, ist ein monumentales Chor-Epos aus dem Jahr 1906, das ein riesiges Ensemble aus Solisten, Chören und einem gewaltigen Orchester erfordert. (Special) - 2026-03-28

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgischen Konzerte, BWV 1046-1051
classica.us.description: Václav Luks dirigiert das Collegium 1704 in Johann Sebastian Bachs Brandenburgische Konzerte 1-6. Im Jubiläumsjahr 2021 wurden sie im neu restaurierten Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses mit dem Collegium 1704 aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2022-02-20

classica.us.title: Mahler, Symphonie Nr. 1 D-Dur
classica.us.description: Die Wiener Philharmoniker unter der Leitung von Leonard Bernstein spielen die Symphonie Nr. 1 D-Dur von Gustav Mahler (1860-1911). Diese Aufnahme entstand im Oktober 1974 im Wiener Konzerthaus. Als erster Dirigent nahm Leonard Bernstein alle Symphonien Gustav Mahlers nicht nur auf Schallplatte, sondern auch auf Video auf. Bernsteins Mahler-Zyklus ist ein einzigartiges musikalisches Dokument und trug zu einem neuen Verständnis von Mahlers Werk bei. (Special, Music) - 2012-12-06

classica.us.title: Liszt - Zwei sinfonische Dichtungen
classica.us.description: Franz Liszt verfasste 13 sinfonische Dichtungen, die von literarischen Texten inspiriert waren. Der Komponist schrieb Klavier-Duette für diese Dichtungen, die sein beeindruckendes Talent zeigten, ein volles Orchester mit nur einem Piano zu imitieren. (Special, Music) - 2025-08-15

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 2, Op. 36
classica.us.description: Martha Argerich spielt mit dem Lucerne Festival Orchestra unter der Leitung von Herbert Blomstedt Beethovens zweite Sinfonie. Diese Aufführung wurde im August 2020 im Kultur- und Kongresszentrum Luzern in der Schweiz aufgenommen. (Special, Event, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-07-04

classica.us.title: Martha Argerich - Eine Geburtstagsfeier - III
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich dem Kammermusikrepertoire in einem wunderbaren Konzert. Die "Grande Dame des Klaviers" wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-09-21

classica.us.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
classica.us.description: Die von Carl Orff komponierten „Carmina Burana" sind in den Jahren 1935 und 1936 entstanden. Die Kantate basiert auf 24 Gedichten aus der gleichnamigen mittelalterlichen Sammlung, bestehend aus zumeist lateinischen Lied- und Dramentexten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2020-01-01

classica.us.title: Cartoons in Concert
classica.us.description: Beliebte Figuren aus der Welt der Cartoons und Animationsfilme treffen im Konzertsaal auf eine mitreißende musikalische Fusion. Gemeinsam mit Chören und Orchestern des DR entsteht ein einzigartiges Konzerterlebnis. Seien Sie gespannt! (Special, Music, Concert) - 2024-12-24

classica.us.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C-Dur, Op. 17
classica.us.description: Nachdem er alle 32 Beethoven Klaviersonaten aufgenommen hat, um den 250. Geburtstag des Komponisten zu feiern, entschied sich der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwarz dazu, Soloklavierwerke von Robert Schumann aufzunehmen. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-11-28

classica.us.title: Tales of Two Cities: The Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
classica.us.description: Der Musik und Kultur der Kaffeehäuser des 18. Jahrhunderts in Leipzig und Damaskus wird mit Werken von Bach, Telemann und Händel, sowie mit klassischer arabischer Musik Tribut gezollt. Das Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra spielt in Toronto. (Special, Music, Classical)

classica.us.title: Brahms Tragische Ouvertüre & Mahler Sinfonie Nr. 1
Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin
classica.us.description: Für Freunde und Musiker war und ist die Schweizer Klaviervirtuosin Clara Haskil eine Interpretin, die wie keine andere Maßstäbe gesetzt hat. Anhand von Klaviereinspielungen, Briefen und Interviews zeigt der Film die Musikerin in neuem Licht. (Special, Documentary, Biography, Art) - 2017-08-27

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 4
classica.us.description: Gustav Mahlers Sinfonie Nr. 4, komponiert zwischen 1899 und 1901, schildert die kindliche Vorstellung vom Himmel, ein zentrales Thema, das den unschuldigen und lyrischen Charakter des Werkes prägt. (Special, Music) - 2026-02-28

classica.us.title: Rachmaninow - 1. Klavierkonzert,, Op. 1

Blusette soon realizes, however, that 8-Ball is a small-time crook, hoping to use her and her renown to benefit his various schemes. Blusette tells him to take a hike, and she turns up dead a short while later. Freddy then tries to uncover the truth about Blusette, while 8-Ball works to frame him. (Crime drama) - 1998

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. travel.us.title: Unexplained: Caught on Camera - Possessive Attachment & The Girl In The Pub
travel.us.description: A possessive attachment makes one couple fear for the future of their unborn son; two explorers make contact with the spirit of a young girl; and an amazing capture of an elderly lady leaves two mediums shaken to their core. (Performing Arts, Reality TV)

travel.us.title: Alien Highway - Missouri Mayhem
travel.us.description: A rash of recent UFO sightings brings Chuck and the team to Missouri, the home of the 1973 Piedmont lights incident; armed with new evidence, they tackle whether history is repeating itself. (Travel, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Alien Highway - UFO Terror
travel.us.description: A Missouri man who claims UFOs are stalking him reaches out to Chuck and the team for help; during the intense investigation, they uncover a dark secret which may explain why their client is experiencing so much UFO activity. (Travel, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Alien Highway - Murder on the Prairie
travel.us.description: Mysterious animal deaths and UFO sightings bring Chuck to Colorado to search for an explanation; reports of the incidents are going unanswered by authorities, leading him to wonder if it's a government cover-up. (Travel, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Alien Highway - UFO Recovery
travel.us.description: Chuck receives a map from an informant leading to an alleged cache of recovered materials from the Roswell incident; he and his team go on the treasure hunt of lifetime to locate what could be the mother lode of all UFO discoveries. (Travel, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Alien Highway - Legend of the Skinwalker
travel.us.description: Chuck and the team investigate the recent sighting of a possible shape-shifter near Utah's Skinwalker Ranch. (Travel, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Alien Highway - SoCal Clusters
travel.us.description: Chuck and the team investigate UFO sightings in and out of the water off the coast of southern California; they probe the connection between UFOs, the military and the ocean itself. (Travel, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Alaska Triangle - The Secrets of Mount Hayes
travel.us.description: An eyewitness shares startling video evidence of extraterrestrial activity in Fairbanks, Alaska; a UFO hunter flies over Alaska's highest mountain in search of a secret underground alien base. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Alaska Triangle - Alaskan Bigfoot and Mysterious Forcefields of the Triangle
travel.us.description: A cryptozoologist hunts for scientific proof of Bigfoot in the remote Alaskan wilderness; experts investigate a mysterious vortex of energy that may be behind unexplained disappearances and paranormal activity in the Alaska Triangle. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Alaska Triangle - The Missing Douglas
travel.us.description: Experts investigate whether an interdimensional portal in the Alaska Triangle led to the disappearance of an airplane carrying 44 military personnel in 1950. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Alaska Triangle - The Hairyman of Port Chatham and Frozen in Ice
travel.us.description: Seasoned Bigfoot hunters investigate whether a huge, ape-like beast is responsible for a string of disappearances and mutilations in the remote Alaskan wilderness; new evidence suggests woolly mammoths may have found safe haven in Alaska. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Alaska Triangle - The Alaskan Loch Ness Monster
travel.us.description: Most waterways of Alaska are still unexplored; local folklore tells of hidden channels and monstrous beasts lurking in the depths; one of the most terrifying of all those beasts is said to live in Lake Iliamna. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Alaska Triangle - The Haunted Cabin and Alaskan Giants
travel.us.description: A young mother's idyllic Alaskan dream soon descends into a paranormal nightmare as she starts to suffer attacks by an unseen force; recent sightings may prove that a Native American legend about a mysterious race of giants is true. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Alaska Triangle - Alaska's Most Haunted Building and Curse of the Kushtaka
travel.us.description: An aggressive spirit attacks guests at a historic hotel in Juneau, Alaska, and a shape-shifting menace could be responsible for thousands of abductions in the Alaska Triangle. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Alaska Triangle - The Alaskan Titanic
travel.us.description: In 1918 the SS Princess Sophia mysteriously sinks near Juneau, Alaska; experts seek answers to the cause of the shipwreck as a ghost hunter attempts to contact victims. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Alaska Triangle - Alaskan Underwater UFOs and Ghost Ships
travel.us.description: Compelling evidence suggests extraterrestrial visitors are hiding in the unexplored depths of the ocean; experts investigate the reports of ghost ships haunting the high seas around Alaska. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: The Alaska Triangle - The Mystery of Flight 1628 and The Giant Thunderbird
travel.us.description: One of the most-famous UFO cases of all time occurred in the skies above Alaska when an unidentified flying object pursued a Boeing 747; locals suspect a monstrous bird is behind many disappearances in the Alaska Triangle. (Paranormal)
